content.content:
# EHL Atira Challenge: priority plan

Written 10 Oct 2026, 13:15 UTC, from every page of ehl-challenge.atira.ai, the run brief for `public-1`, the
starter kit and the API spec. Raw copies are in `notes/`.

State of the board at that time: 25 teams, 4 ranked, best quality **21.5 / 100**, three teams at 0. The bar is low
right now. A bid that is signed, on the right tender, with the right materials and quantities, is already first.

---

## 1. The game on one screen

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Job | One tender spread over 4 German websites: tender portal (Vergabeportal), supplier portal with the spec (Lieferantenportal), ERP, webmail (Werkpost). Apply the bid rules, enter one priced bid in the tender portal's configurator, sign it with a TAN from the mail. |
| Who decides | A model must choose where to go, what to search and which documents matter, at run time. Code may help: extract a page the model opened, parse a document it picked, paginate a result set it asked for, calculate, validate, retry, fill forms. |
| Clock | Scored run 20 min. Test run up to 2 h (keep it under 20). Setup (max 5 min) and model warm-up are not counted. |
| Browsers | Up to 4 headful Chromium over CDP (`"browsers": 4` in agent.json). Starting your own browser gets it killed. |
| Models | Free hosted Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (OpenAI API, tools, images, 256k) and Clef (yes/no, choice, score). Own keys allowed as team secrets, through the proxy, metered. |
| Answer | Entered on the website. Exactly one submission, and it ends the run. A run with no answer scores 0. |
| Ranking | Eligible (correct tender reference) → quality 0-100 → cost × time (lower is better). |
| Winners | 1. private dataset run, 2. public leaderboard, 3. elegance of the system. |
| Final run | Your **latest** submission that passed review (not your best), on a private dataset: other software, layout, site names, data, and the facts split differently across the sites. Same jobs, same rules, same answer format. |

## 2. What this means (the rules that decide everything else)

1. **Generalise, don't tune.** The final is on websites nobody has seen. No click paths, no URL paths, no CSS
   selectors tied to the public sites. The agent reads the brief at run time and finds things itself.
2. **Quality first, by far.** Cost × time only breaks ties at equal quality. Never trade points for speed. But the
   20 minutes are hard: a late answer is 0.
3. **The last upload is the one that goes to the final.** Never submit an experiment late in the day. Keep every
   tarball you submit, so you can re-submit a known good one.
4. **Opt in to best of 3** for the final (`atira final --best-of 3`). With the free models it costs nothing and only
   the best attempt counts.
5. **Eligibility is nearly free.** The tender reference is in the brief. The only way to lose it is to bid on a
   look-alike tender or not submit at all.
6. **The submission flow is the gate.** No signed bid means 0. Most teams are stuck there. Build it first.

## 3. Where the 100 points are

Bid case (from the brief and scoring docs):

| Part | Points |
| --- | --- |
| Decision (bid / no_bid) | 5 |
| Tender reference | 5 |
| Discount percent | 5 |
| Total net, to the cent | 5 |
| Arithmetic consistency (total = sum of quantity × unit price) | 5 |
| Withdrawn Q&A quantity check (when present) | 5 |
| Dated metal-index check (when present) | 5 |
| Positions, split evenly | 75 minus the two checks, so about 65 |

Inside the positions block, summed over all positions (assuming the 65-point block):

| Field | Weight | ≈ Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| material_number | 20 % | 13 |
| quantity | 15 % | 9.75 |
| base_unit_price | 15 % | 9.75 |
| surcharge_per_unit | 10 % | 6.5 |
| packaging_per_unit | 10 % | 6.5 |
| rebate_total (project bonus) | 10 % | 6.5 |
| unit_price (final) | 10 % | 6.5 |
| lead_time_weeks | 10 % | 6.5 |

No-bid case: decision 75, reference 5, no positions 5, total 0 → 15. A wrong bid / no_bid call is the most expensive
mistake in the game. Every field scores on its own, there is no penalty for a wrong value, so **always fill every
field with the best estimate rather than leave it blank.** Money is compared to the cent. Extra or duplicate
positions cost one position's share each.

### The ladder (build in this order)

| Step | What the agent gets right | Adds | Running total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | Signed bid, right tender, decision, total = sum (code guarantees it) | 15 | 15 |
| B | Material per position + final quantity (incl. withdrawn Q&A, Satz → pieces) | ≈ 28 | ≈ 43 |
| C | Lead time (stock pooling, commitments) + discount (director mail, threshold) | ≈ 11.5 | ≈ 54 |
| D | Base price (valid condition, scale, price unit, FX to EUR) | ≈ 10 | ≈ 64 |
| E | Surcharge (metal index by date window, setup, shared setup pool) | ≈ 11.5 | ≈ 76 |
| F | Packaging + project bonus | ≈ 13 | ≈ 89 |
| G | Final unit price + total (only right when everything else is) | ≈ 11.5 | 100 |

Step B alone beats today's leader. Steps A and B are where to spend the first half of the day.

---

## 4. Priorities, in order

### P0. Setup (first 30 min)

- [ ] Ask the organizers now: submission deadline, when the final run starts, prizes. Read `/announcements`.
- [ ] Team on the site (up to 5, GitHub invites). `atira login` on each laptop.
- [ ] `claude mcp add atira -- atira mcp` so Claude Code can start test runs, read logs and see screenshots.
- [ ] `atira final --best-of 3` (can be changed until the final starts, do it now so it is never forgotten).
- [ ] GitHub repo created and linked on the team page (organizers ask for it, and elegance is judged on code).
- [ ] Starter kit in `ehl-hackathon/agent/`. **That folder is the package root.** Notes and hand-solved answers stay
      outside it and out of git.
- [ ] `atira models proxy` running in its own terminal; `eval "$(atira scout --env)"` in the dev terminal.

### P1. Hand-solve public-1 once (60-90 min, in parallel with P2 if you have teammates)

- Log into the 4 sites with the scouting logins (`atira scout`) and work out the whole answer by hand, rule by rule.
  Save it as `notes/expected-public-1.json`. Never copy it into `agent/`.
- Why: test runs show points per field but never the right values. A hand answer lets you diff every field in
  seconds on local runs, and it forces you to understand every rule before coding it.
- While doing it, write down **patterns, not values**: where each kind of fact lives, how search works, what breaks
  (popups, timeouts, paging, iframes, ZIPs). These become generic hints in the prompt.

### P2. Thin end-to-end that submits (the gate)

- Generic browser tools (section 5). Login, cookie wall, error retry and re-login are helpers.
- Submitter agent that takes a finished answer JSON plus the brief's submission paragraph and completes the form,
  the TAN and the final dialog. Test it locally with a dummy answer (scouting submissions never count).
- First goal: Step A + B. Then **submit once** to get on the board with an eligible result.

### P3. Climb the ladder (C → G)

- Each step is: a fact the investigators must find + a function in the calculator + a unit test.
- After each step: local run → diff against `expected-public-1.json` → test run in the sandbox for the breakdown.
- Submit a new scored version whenever test runs show a clear gain and it is stable over 2+ runs.

### P4. Robustness for the private dataset (this is what wins)

- Grep the package for any public value: tender reference, company name, VAT id, material numbers, prices, names,
  URL paths, German button labels not in the brief. Zero hits.
- Never assume which site holds which fact. The investigators collect every fact type they see, and a gap check
  sends targeted searches to any site for what is still missing.
- Every UI wording the submitter uses comes from the brief at run time, not from code.
- Run 3-4 test runs of the same package in parallel. Judge by the worst run, not the best.
- Handle no_bid end to end (Verzichtserklärung path) even though public-1 is probably a bid.

### P5. Speed and cost (only once quality is flat)

- Small observations, prompt caching (cached Qwen input is about 10× cheaper), 4 browsers in parallel.
- Clef for cheap yes/no calls (is this the current revision, is this the right mail).
- Only the tie-break uses this, plus a possible small prize for the fastest, cheapest passing run.

---

## 5. Architecture to build

**Model decides, code checks, code computes.** That is robust, easy to defend in review, and reads as elegant.

```
brief (run time) ──► planner: list of facts the rules need
                         │
     ┌──────────────┬────┴─────────┬──────────────┐
     ▼              ▼              ▼              ▼
 tender agent   spec agent     mail agent     erp agent        (one browser each, LLM-driven loops)
 (browser 1)    (browser 2)    (browser 3)    (browser 4)
     └──────────────┴──── evidence ledger ────────┘            (every fact: value, source URL, date, sender, quote)
                         │
                   gap check (model) ──► targeted follow-up searches
                         │
                   rules engine (pure Python, Decimal) ──► answer JSON + self-checks
                         │
                   submitter agent (tender portal + TAN from mail) ──► signed bid
```

### Browser tools (generic, the same on any website)

- `observe()`: compact page text plus numbered interactive elements, tables as rows, content of iframes included.
  Keep it small. Screenshot only when the text is ambiguous (Qwen reads images).
- `click(ref)`, `type(ref, text)`, `select(ref, option)`, `press(key)`, `goto(url)`, `open_tab()`.
- `download_and_read(ref)`: fetch a file the model chose, unzip, extract PDF/HTML/CSV text.
- Auto-helpers the model never has to think about: cookie wall, flaky error page retry, session expired → log in
  again with the run's credentials and return, JS dialogs logged and accepted.
- Never use the browser Back button in the bid form (it clears later steps).

### Agents

- Investigators: one loop per site, with a `record_fact` tool. Each fact carries type, key, value, unit, date with
  timezone, sender, tender reference and a short quote. The model chooses searches and pages.
- ERP agent starts per position once the requirement (after amendments and stroke derivation) and Kataloggruppe are
  known. Positions can be looked up in parallel tabs.
- The model makes the important choices (which tender, which revision is current, which material matches, which mail
  applies). Code then checks them against the rules (dates, exact reference, sender domain, exact attribute match). If
  code disagrees, show the model the conflict and let it decide again.

### Rules engine (pure function, the core of the score)

- `Decimal` everywhere, `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Python `round()` is banker's rounding and will lose cents.
- One function per brief rule, with the rule quoted in a comment, and unit tests with obviously fake numbers.
- Output is always schema-valid, and `total_net` always equals the sum of quantity × unit price.

### Clock guard

- Read `expires_at` from the run. Target: investigation done by about minute 10, submission started by minute 13 at
  the latest, whatever is missing.
- Below about 5 minutes left: stop everything, compute with what you have, submit. A partial bid with the right
  reference beats a perfect bid that is late.
- Measure how long the submission flow takes in test runs and set the cut-off from that number.

### Models

- Start with Qwen for everything: free, unlimited test runs, tiny simulated cost.
- If one step keeps failing (multi-step rule reading, long mails), move only that step to a stronger model with your
  own key as a team secret. Quality beats cost.

right now. A bid that is signed, on the right tender, with the right materials and quantities, is already first.

---

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Job | One tender spread over 4 German websites: tender portal (Vergabeportal), supplier portal with the spec (Lieferantenportal), ERP, webmail (Werkpost). Apply the bid rules, enter one priced bid in the tender portal's configurator, sign it with a TAN from the mail. |

| Clock | Scored run 20 min. Test run up to 2 h (keep it under 20). Setup (max 5 min) and model warm-up are not counted. |

| Models | Free hosted Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (OpenAI API, tools, images, 256k) and Clef (yes/no, choice, score). Own keys allowed as team secrets, through the proxy, metered. |

| Ranking | Eligible (correct tender reference) → quality 0-100 → cost × time (lower is better). |
| Winners | 1. private dataset run, 2. public leaderboard, 3. elegance of the system. |

   selectors tied to the public sites. The agent reads the brief at run time and finds things itself.

| Part | Points |
| --- | --- |
| Decision (bid / no_bid) | 5 |
| Tender reference | 5 |
| Discount percent | 5 |
| Total net, to the cent | 5 |
| Arithmetic consistency (total = sum of quantity × unit price) | 5 |
| Withdrawn Q&A quantity check (when present) | 5 |
| Dated metal-index check (when present) | 5 |
| Positions, split evenly | 75 minus the two checks, so about 65 |

| Field | Weight | ≈ Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| material_number | 20 % | 13 |
| quantity | 15 % | 9.75 |
| base_unit_price | 15 % | 9.75 |

| lead_time_weeks | 10 % | 6.5 |

Yes, I'm connected to your Chrome. I've opened all 4 sites in my tab group, but every session expired overnight, so each one is on its login page ("Sitzung abgelaufen"). I don't type passwords, so this part is yours.

**What you need to do now:**
1. In Chrome, open the Claude tab group. It has 4 tabs: Vergabeportal, Lieferantenportal, ERP, Werkpost.
2. Sign in on each tab. Each site has its own password; `atira scout` prints all four:
   ```bash
   atira scout
   ```
3. Tell me **"logged in"**.

**Your other questions:**
- **No runs without your OK.** I won't start a local run or a sandbox test run until you say so.
- **The sandbox:** I can't click through the pages of a sandbox test run. It runs our agent in Atira's cloud on its own copy of the sites, and I can only start it (with your OK) and read its log, score breakdown and screenshots. The sites in your Chrome have the same public data, though, and the docs say an answer entered there "is acknowledged but never counts". So I can do the whole test bid by hand there, TAN included. One catch: the login is shared by all teams, so another team's TAN request can cancel ours.

**Once you're logged in, here's how I'll work toward 100 points:**
1. **Read every fact the scoring needs, by hand.** That's all Q&A pages on the tender portal and the current spec revision with its requirements and catalogue groups. On the ERP it's materials, prices, stock and lead times. In the mail it's the discount approval, the condition rules, the price indices, packaging, setup pools, project bonus and the technical release.
2. **Work out the full correct answer** with our calculator and save it as `notes/expected-public-1.json`. That gives us a target to compare every run against.
3. **Write a page-by-page map** in `notes/site-map-public-1.md`: where each fact lives, the traps, and how many steps it takes. Then I'll estimate how to fit it all into 20 minutes.
4. **Finish mapping the bid form.** I'll fill it in up to the TAN, then ask you before I request the TAN and before the final submit.

When I reach an "Ich bin kein Roboter" check (ERP and mail), I'll stop and tell you exactly what to click.

echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc

content.text:
The ERP logged us out the moment I clicked "Weiter": it went back to the login page. Its session expires after a short idle time, and the few minutes the robot check took were too long.

The fix is to do the whole ERP entry in one go, so I can start the moment it's open. **Please, on the ERP tab:**
1. Sign in. Accept the cookie notice, and if you see "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar", click "Erneut versuchen".
2. Drag the slider all the way right and tick **"Ich bin kein Roboter"**.
3. Type the **Empfangsnummer** shown at the top (it looks like `PRD-123456`; it's new every time) into the field, tick **"Betriebsbedingungen gelesen"** and click **"Weiter"**.
4. Tell me **"ERP in"** right away.

Leave the mailbox for now. It would time out while I'm in the ERP, so we'll do it right after the ERP, the same way.

scope = {"01.01": "base", "01.02": "base", "01.03": "none", "01.04": "base", "01.05": "base+mass"}
setup = {"01.03": D("85.00"), "01.05": D("57.50")}
members = ["01.03", "01.04", "01.05"]
rate = 1 - D(5) / 100

def split(total, weights):
    W = sum(weights.values()); exact = {k: total * w / W for k, w in weights.items()}
    share = {k: v.quantize(C, rounding=ROUND_DOWN) for k, v in exact.items()}
    left = int((total - sum(share.values())) / C)
    for k in sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - share[k]), k))[:left]:
        share[k] += C
    return share

pool = split(D("517.25"), {k: q[k] * amass[mat[k]] for k in members})
goods = {k: q[k] * base[k] for k in members}
G = sum(goods.values())
credit = m(max(D(0), min(G, D(15000)) - D(5000)) * D("0.02") + max(D(0), G - D(15000)) * D("0.05"))
bonus = split(credit, goods)
lead = {"01.01": 2, "01.02": 3, "01.03": 11, "01.04": 3, "01.05": 3}
hand, total = [], D(0)
for k in q:
    mass = smass[mat[k]] * metal
    s = setup.get(k, D(0)) + pool.get(k, D(0))
    pack = math.ceil(q[k] / carton[mat[k]]) * D("13.25")
    b = bonus.get(k, D(0))
    db = base[k] * rate if scope[k] != "none" else base[k]
    dm = mass * rate if scope[k] == "base+mass" else mass
    unit = m(db + dm + (s + pack - b) / q[k])
    total += q[k] * unit
    hand.append({"position": k, "material_number": mat[k], "quantity": q[k], "unit_price": float(unit),
                 "lead_time_weeks": lead[k], "base_unit_price": float(base[k]),
                 "surcharge_per_unit": float(m(mass + s / q[k])), "packaging_per_unit": float(m(pack / q[k])),
                 "rebate_total": float(b)})
hand_answer = {"tender_reference": "VG-2027-7093", "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": 5.0,
               "positions": hand, "total_net": float(m(total))}

print("calc.py log:"); [print("  ", line) for line in log]
print("\npool shares:", {k: str(v) for k, v in pool.items()}, " bonus credit:", credit, {k: str(v) for k, v in bonus.items()})
print("goods total (bonus base):", G, "  order value:", m(sum(q[k] * base[k] for k in q)))
same = json.dumps(answer, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(hand_answer, sort_keys=True)
print("\ncalc.py == hand:", same)
if not same:
    print("calc:", json.dumps(answer, indent=1)); print("hand:", json.dumps(hand_answer, indent=1))
json.dump(hand_answer, open("/Users/youssefabdelaal/HackathonFinal/notes/expected-public-1.json", "w"), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(hand_answer, indent=1))

# public-1: site map and the path to 100 points in under 20 minutes

Mapped by hand on 10 Oct 2026 in Chrome with the scouting logins. Facts and sources: `facts-public-1.md`.
Expected answer (computed twice, `calc.py` and by hand, identical): `expected-public-1.json`.
Public values stay in `notes/`; only the generic lessons (section 4) may go into the agent.

## 1. The answer and where its 100 points come from

Decision **bid**, discount **5 %**, total net **356 949,62 EUR**.

| Pos | Material | Qty (pcs) | Base | Surcharge/pc | Packaging/pc | Bonus (position) | Unit price | Weeks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01.01 | HZ-1609 | 25 | 2743.58 | 6.69 | 1.59 | 0.00 | 2614.68 | 2 |
| 01.02 | HZ-2170 | 29 | 705.15 | 5.91 | 4.57 | 0.00 | 680.37 | 3 |
| 01.03 | HZ-2170 | 16 | 753.23 | 12.57 | 4.97 | 580.41 | 734.49 | 11 |
| 01.04 | HZ-3916 | 21 | 2107.18 | 5.25 | 1.26 | 2131.11 | 1906.85 | 3 |
| 01.05 | HZ-6932 | 130 | 1866.15 | 8.06 | 1.94 | 11683.58 | 1692.74 | 3 |

| Points | What earns them | The fact that decides it | Where it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | decision | every requirement has an active match (A-2 and A-4 only after the end-reserve derivation) | spec + Q&A + technik@ mail + ERP |
| 5 | reference | VG-2027-7093, not the look-alikes | brief |
| 5 | discount 5 % | latest leitung@ approval (24.01 17:00), threshold 1,00 EUR | mail inbox |
| 5 | withdrawn Q&A check | 01.05 = 26 Satz × 5 = 130 (8152 withdrawn by 8153) | Q&A page 1 + 3 |
| 5 | metal-index check | 3,15 EUR/kg (window containing 25.01), not 3,95 (last listed) | mail inbox |
| 65 | 5 positions × 13 | material 20 %, qty 15 %, base 15 %, surcharge 10 %, packaging 10 %, bonus 10 %, unit price 10 %, weeks 10 % | all four sites |
| 5 | total | exact to the cent | calc |
| 5 | arithmetic consistency | total = Σ qty × unit price | calc |

## 2. Page by page

### Tender portal (Vergabeportal), times Europe/Athens

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /login → /consent | login (code), "Notwendige Cookies akzeptieren" | session expires after idle minutes |
| 2 | / (search) | open the tender with the exact reference | 16 tenders on 6 pages; reference text has zero-width spaces; fake browser bar + fake download bar ("Sitzungsprotokoll (lokal) Öffnen") |
| 3 | /tenders/VG-2027-7093 | "Teilnahme bekunden" (already registered on the shared login) | survey popup "Kurze Umfrage" swallows the next click: close with ×, never "Akzeptieren und fortfahren" (→ /portal-survey) |
| 4 | menu "Verfahrensakte ▾" → Unterlagen | LV = documents/0 (CSV in a collapsed "Inhalt anzeigen"); documents/1 Leistungsbeschreibung; documents/2 Positionsübersicht | 3 shuffled "Öffnen" buttons per document, only `/documents/N` is real |
| 5 | Verfahrensakte → Bieterfragen | frame `questions-frame` → frame `questions-content` (2 nested iframes); 3 answers per page, 6 pages | pages past the last repeat the last page; answer numbers are NOT chronological (3916 is newer than 8148): sort by date |
| 6 | Angebotsabgabe | the bid form (section 3) | |

### Supplier portal (Lieferantenportal)

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /consent | accept necessary cookies | three "Dokumentenübersicht" links, two go to the supplier guide |
| 2 | /documents (register, 1 document per page, 4 pages) | page 3 = LH-VG-2027-7093 → /documents/specification | other 3 documents are filler |
| 3 | release gate | purpose "Verbindliche Unterlagen zur Kenntnis genommen", copy the displayed Belegnummer into its field, tick "Überlassungsbedingungen gelesen", "Leseberechtigung anfordern" | "Archivkopie" / "Nur Vorschau" grant nothing; popup "Dokumentenanzeige" → close with "Schließen" (its link goes to the guide) |
| 4 | Revisionsjournal | pick the revision with status **gültig** (R-6156) | mixed date formats (MM/TT vs TT/MM); higher number R-9711 is superseded; viewer opens the OLDEST revision by default |
| 5 | /documents/specification/viewer?revision=R-6156&page=1..5 | one requirement per page: Originalwortlaut has bore, stroke, pressure, mounting, cert, Kataloggruppe, nutzbarer Weg + Endreserve key, pieces per Satz | decoy line "Zertifizierung: ISO 9001; Hub: 999 mm; Druck: 999 bar"; numbers tagged (en-US)/(de-DE) |

### ERP (SAP GUI style), times UTC

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /notice | slider + "Ich bin kein Roboter", then copy the Empfangsnummer (PRD-…), tick "Betriebsbedingungen gelesen", Weiter | "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" → "Erneut versuchen"; **very short idle timeout**: do the gate and continue immediately |
| 2 | /search?transaction=MM03&q=GR-xxxx | one search per Kataloggruppe (1–2 hits each) | result list is a role=dialog section (don't strip dialogs); "Wartungshinweis" modal → × (its link goes home); empty/broad search lists nothing |
| 3 | /mm03?material=X&tab=technical | bore/stroke/pressure/mounting/cert | |
| 4 | /mm03?material=X&tab=planning | status + lead times | status: visible `<output>` value counts; a hidden "03" span next to it is a decoy. HZ-8405 is **03 = blocked** although it matches A-1 |
| 5 | /mmbe?material=X&level=stock | "Frei verwendbar" quantity = usable stock | overview shows physical stock INCLUDING blocked inspection stock (Prüfbestand) |
| 6 | /vk13?material=X&view=scales (&page=N for more condition records) | validity, currency + FX key, price unit, number format, scales | price unit 100 ST; en-US "238,098" = 238098 per 100; de-DE "181.429" = 181429 per 100; 2026 record on page 2 is not valid |

The search line itself already carries pcs/carton, Umlagegewicht (allocation, g), Zuschlagsmasse (surcharge mass, g) and the price index key.

### Mail (Werkpost), times Europe/Berlin, mailbox vertrieb@linden-hydraulik.example

content.text:
All 4 sites are mapped and every fact the scoring needs has been read. I worked out the full correct answer twice, by hand and with our `calc.py`, and the two match to the cent: **bid, 5% discount, total net €356,949.62**.

**What the old agent run got wrong**, and why it scored 0 (none of these are in the agent yet):
- **Wrong material for A-1.** HZ-8405 matches A-1 on paper but is blocked; the old run picked it. The right one is HZ-1609.
- **Fake mail content.** Every mail has a fake "unsent draft, 99%, Keine Freigabe" box, and the old run believed it. The real text is under "Nachrichtentext (Original)".
- **Outdated discount.** The old run used 4% from an older mail; the newest approval says **5%**.
- **Archive folder.** Half the mails are in the Archiv folder, which shows nothing until you search it.
- **Hidden pages.** The Q&A sits two frames deep. The spec only opens after the release form with the receipt number, and the viewer opens the oldest revision first.
- **A-2 and A-4 match only after the end-reserve step** (482 + 2×9 = 500, 576 + 2×12 = 600). Without it, the agent would wrongly submit no_bid.

**Fitting it into 20 minutes:** with the 4 browsers in parallel, the plan finishes in about 14 minutes and leaves 6 spare. The slowest parts are the ERP, which has to wait for the catalogue groups from the spec, and filling in the bid form.

**Files** (git ignores them, and they must never go into `agent/`):
- [notes/site-map-public-1.md](notes/site-map-public-1.md): page-by-page map, traps, lessons for the agent, 20-minute plan
- [notes/facts-public-1.md](notes/facts-public-1.md): every fact with where it came from
- [notes/expected-public-1.json](notes/expected-public-1.json): the target answer to compare runs against

**Still unmapped:** the end of the bid form (totals page, document acknowledgement, TAN, final dialog). To finish it:
1. You sign in on the **"Anmeldung – Vergabeportal"** tab (the tender portal timed out).
2. I fill in the whole form with the correct answer, up to the TAN request.
3. I ask before requesting the TAN. Since the login is shared, our request cancels whatever TAN another team has open, and theirs ours.
4. You sign in to the mailbox and unlock the TAN mail; I read the TAN and enter it.
5. You click OK in the final browser dialog, because I can't click inside that dialog.

The answer is "acknowledged but never counts" on these practice logins. Should I go ahead once you've signed in? After that, the next step would be putting the generic lessons into the agent and doing a local run, with your OK, to compare it against the expected answer.

so a human-in-the-loop submission loses the race (3 attempts on 10 Oct: wrong mail #169 vs ours #168; #170 superseded by
#171/#172 within 2 minutes). In a scored run every run has its own logins, so the agent only has to read mail N and
submit within seconds. The final confirm is a native JS dialog: Playwright must accept it via `page.on("dialog")`.

# public-1: site map and the path to 100 points in under 20 minutes

Mapped by hand on 10 Oct 2026 in Chrome with the scouting logins. Facts and sources: `facts-public-1.md`.
Expected answer (computed twice, `calc.py` and by hand, identical): `expected-public-1.json`.
Public values stay in `notes/`; only the generic lessons (section 4) may go into the agent.

## 1. The answer and where its 100 points come from

Decision **bid**, discount **5 %**, total net **356 949,62 EUR**.

| Pos | Material | Qty (pcs) | Base | Surcharge/pc | Packaging/pc | Bonus (position) | Unit price | Weeks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01.01 | HZ-1609 | 25 | 2743.58 | 6.69 | 1.59 | 0.00 | 2614.68 | 2 |
| 01.02 | HZ-2170 | 29 | 705.15 | 5.91 | 4.57 | 0.00 | 680.37 | 3 |
| 01.03 | HZ-2170 | 16 | 753.23 | 12.57 | 4.97 | 580.41 | 734.49 | 11 |
| 01.04 | HZ-3916 | 21 | 2107.18 | 5.25 | 1.26 | 2131.11 | 1906.85 | 3 |
| 01.05 | HZ-6932 | 130 | 1866.15 | 8.06 | 1.94 | 11683.58 | 1692.74 | 3 |

| Points | What earns them | The fact that decides it | Where it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | decision | every requirement has an active match (A-2 and A-4 only after the end-reserve derivation) | spec + Q&A + technik@ mail + ERP |
| 5 | reference | VG-2027-7093, not the look-alikes | brief |
| 5 | discount 5 % | latest leitung@ approval (24.01 17:00), threshold 1,00 EUR | mail inbox |
| 5 | withdrawn Q&A check | 01.05 = 26 Satz × 5 = 130 (8152 withdrawn by 8153) | Q&A page 1 + 3 |
| 5 | metal-index check | 3,15 EUR/kg (window containing 25.01), not 3,95 (last listed) | mail inbox |
| 65 | 5 positions × 13 | material 20 %, qty 15 %, base 15 %, surcharge 10 %, packaging 10 %, bonus 10 %, unit price 10 %, weeks 10 % | all four sites |
| 5 | total | exact to the cent | calc |
| 5 | arithmetic consistency | total = Σ qty × unit price | calc |

## 2. Page by page

### Tender portal (Vergabeportal), times Europe/Athens

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /login → /consent | login (code), "Notwendige Cookies akzeptieren" | session expires after idle minutes |
| 2 | / (search) | open the tender with the exact reference | 16 tenders on 6 pages; reference text has zero-width spaces; fake browser bar + fake download bar ("Sitzungsprotokoll (lokal) Öffnen") |
| 3 | /tenders/VG-2027-7093 | "Teilnahme bekunden" (already registered on the shared login) | survey popup "Kurze Umfrage" swallows the next click: close with ×, never "Akzeptieren und fortfahren" (→ /portal-survey) |
| 4 | menu "Verfahrensakte ▾" → Unterlagen | LV = documents/0 (CSV in a collapsed "Inhalt anzeigen"); documents/1 Leistungsbeschreibung; documents/2 Positionsübersicht | 3 shuffled "Öffnen" buttons per document, only `/documents/N` is real |
| 5 | Verfahrensakte → Bieterfragen | frame `questions-frame` → frame `questions-content` (2 nested iframes); 3 answers per page, 6 pages | pages past the last repeat the last page; answer numbers are NOT chronological (3916 is newer than 8148): sort by date |
| 6 | Angebotsabgabe | the bid form (section 3) | |

### Supplier portal (Lieferantenportal)

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /consent | accept necessary cookies | three "Dokumentenübersicht" links, two go to the supplier guide |
| 2 | /documents (register, 1 document per page, 4 pages) | page 3 = LH-VG-2027-7093 → /documents/specification | other 3 documents are filler |
| 3 | release gate | purpose "Verbindliche Unterlagen zur Kenntnis genommen", copy the displayed Belegnummer into its field, tick "Überlassungsbedingungen gelesen", "Leseberechtigung anfordern" | "Archivkopie" / "Nur Vorschau" grant nothing; popup "Dokumentenanzeige" → close with "Schließen" (its link goes to the guide) |
| 4 | Revisionsjournal | pick the revision with status **gültig** (R-6156) | mixed date formats (MM/TT vs TT/MM); higher number R-9711 is superseded; viewer opens the OLDEST revision by default |
| 5 | /documents/specification/viewer?revision=R-6156&page=1..5 | one requirement per page: Originalwortlaut has bore, stroke, pressure, mounting, cert, Kataloggruppe, nutzbarer Weg + Endreserve key, pieces per Satz | decoy line "Zertifizierung: ISO 9001; Hub: 999 mm; Druck: 999 bar"; numbers tagged (en-US)/(de-DE) |

### ERP (SAP GUI style), times UTC

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /notice | slider + "Ich bin kein Roboter", then copy the Empfangsnummer (PRD-…), tick "Betriebsbedingungen gelesen", Weiter | "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" → "Erneut versuchen"; **very short idle timeout**: do the gate and continue immediately |
| 2 | /search?transaction=MM03&q=GR-xxxx | one search per Kataloggruppe (1–2 hits each) | result list is a role=dialog section (don't strip dialogs); "Wartungshinweis" modal → × (its link goes home); empty/broad search lists nothing |
| 3 | /mm03?material=X&tab=technical | bore/stroke/pressure/mounting/cert | |
| 4 | /mm03?material=X&tab=planning | status + lead times | status: visible `<output>` value counts; a hidden "03" span next to it is a decoy. HZ-8405 is **03 = blocked** although it matches A-1 |
| 5 | /mmbe?material=X&level=stock | "Frei verwendbar" quantity = usable stock | overview shows physical stock INCLUDING blocked inspection stock (Prüfbestand) |
| 6 | /vk13?material=X&view=scales (&page=N for more condition records) | validity, currency + FX key, price unit, number format, scales | price unit 100 ST; en-US "238,098" = 238098 per 100; de-DE "181.429" = 181429 per 100; 2026 record on page 2 is not valid |

The search line itself already carries pcs/carton, Umlagegewicht (allocation, g), Zuschlagsmasse (surcharge mass, g) and the price index key.

### Mail (Werkpost), times Europe/Berlin, mailbox vertrieb@linden-hydraulik.example

| Step | Page | What to do | Traps |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /consent, popup "Postfachhinweis" | accept; close popup with × | popup link and the "Original öffnen" decoy go to /tools |
| 2 | search `?folder=inbox|archive&q=VG-2027-7093 <Thema>` | AND search, max 20 hits, 3 per page | **half the mails are in the Archiv folder** (Konditionsregeln, Rüstpools, Technik, Verpackung, Devisen, Projektbonus); the archive lists nothing without a search term; look-alike references "-A"; future-dated Devisenfixing (26.01) |
| 3 | /messages/<id> | slider + robot box per message, then open "Nachrichtentext (Original)" | decoy box "Lokale Vorschau / nicht versandter Entwurf: Entwurfswert 99 %, Keine Freigabe, nicht versandt" in EVERY mail (the old agent run believed it); in some mails the real text sits lower in a scroll box after "Original folgt" |
| 4 | "Umschlag / vollständige Kopfzeilen" | check sender local part + domain and date | |
| 5 | TAN | "Signatur-TAN VG-2027-7093 · Anforderung N": N is the request count, not the TAN; shared login → other teams' requests (N was 146 at 22:30) invalidate ours | |

## 3. Bid form (Angebotsabgabe), mapped up to position 01.03 in the earlier session

1. Company name, USt-IdNr., contact email → Weiter. "Zurück" clears the later steps.
2. Bid type: **Nebenangebot is preselected** → choose Hauptangebot (or Verzichtserklärung for no_bid).
3. Steps 3–7: one page per position in **shuffled order**. Configurator: Bohrung → "Auswahl übernehmen" → Hub → … → Zertifizierung; then
   Katalognummer, quantity in pieces, net unit price (German format), collapsed "Preisaufbau" (base, surcharge, packaging
   per piece; bonus per position), lead time 1–52 weeks. "Position auslassen" = omit; "Position hinzufügen" = trap.
4. Still unmapped: totals page, document acknowledgement, TAN request, summary, final browser dialog.

## 4. Lessons for the agent (generic, safe for the private dataset)

- Read nested iframes to the bottom; collapsed `<details>`/"Inhalt anzeigen" sections must be opened.
- Never trust "last listed" or "highest number": sort by the stated date, parse each date with its stated format.
- Ignore hidden elements (aria-hidden, display:none); read the visible value only (ERP status decoy).
- A message's real body is the "Original" section; draft/preview boxes are decoys.
- Search both mail folders; an empty archive list means "search first", not "nothing there".
- Stock = unrestricted only; inspection/blocked stock never counts.
- Normalise price units and number formats before anything else; convert currency after picking the scale.
- Gates (cookie, release form, receipt numbers) are part of the job and must be finished, not reported.
- Sessions expire within minutes when idle: keep each site busy or re-login automatically and resume.

## 5. 20-minute plan

Four browsers in parallel from second 0. Rough budget at about 1–2 s per model step:

| Time | Tender (B1) | Supplier (B2) | ERP (B3) | Mail (B4) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:30 | login, cookie | login, cookie | login, gate | login, cookie, popup |
| 0:30–3:00 | Q&A 6 pages (17 answers), LV | release gate, revision list, 5 requirement pages | wait for groups (or search all groups seen in the spec) | 9 topic searches over inbox + archive |
| 3:00–7:00 | done → idle | done | 4 groups × (search, technical, planning, stock, scales) | open ~10 mails |
| 7:00–8:00 | | | | |
| 8:00 | gap check by the solver; targeted follow-ups only for missing facts | | | |
| 9:00 | calc (instant), self-checks | | | |
| 9:00–13:00 | bid form: 7 steps, 5 configurators, prices, breakdown | | | |
| 13:00–14:00 | TAN request → B4 reads newest TAN → enter → summary → confirm dialog | | | |

That leaves about 6 minutes of slack. The critical path is ERP (needs Kataloggruppe from the spec) and the bid form.
Cut-off rule: whatever is missing at minute 12, compute with what is there and submit.

"""The entry point (agent.json runs it): the team of agents on the run's clock.

    plan the task from the brief (model)
    investigate every website at once, one agent and one browser each (models navigate and record)
    decide which facts apply (model), then compute the bid (calc.py, exact decimals)
    enter and sign the bid on the submission website (model operates the form, a second agent reads the TAN)

The whole run is bounded by its 20 minutes: investigation stops at INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, the solver has SOLVE_SECONDS,
and the submission starts no later than SUBMIT_RESERVE before the end, whatever is still missing. A partial bid scores; a late one does not.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import calc
import run as contract
import submit
import team
import web

RUN_SECONDS = 20 * 60
INVESTIGATE_UNTIL = 9 * 60  # seconds from the start
SOLVE_SECONDS = 150
SUBMIT_RESERVE = 8 * 60  # entering and signing the bid starts no later than this before the end
FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS = 100


def log(text: str):
    print(text, flush=True)


async def open_sites(playwright, task: dict) -> list[web.Site]:
    """One browser per website: the run's browsers (up to 4), or locally a Chromium each."""
    available = len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or len(task["access"])
    sites, browser = [], None
    for number, access in enumerate(task["access"]):
        if number < available:
            browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
            context = page.context
        else:  # more websites than browsers: a context of its own in the last one
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
        sites.append(web.Site(access, context, page, log))
    return sites


async def work(task: dict, sites: list[web.Site]) -> dict | None:
    start = time.time()
    end = min(start + RUN_SECONDS, task["expires_at"] / 1000) if task.get("expires_at") else start + RUN_SECONDS
    submit_by = end - SUBMIT_RESERVE

    the_plan = await team.plan(task, start + 120)
    log(f"[team] plan: {json.dumps(the_plan, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    ledger = team.Ledger()
    await team.investigate_all(sites, task, the_plan, ledger, min(start + INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, submit_by - SOLVE_SECONDS))
    log(f"[team] {len(ledger.entries)} records after investigating:")
    for entry in ledger.entries:
        log(f"  {json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}")

    inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by))
    by_id = {site.id: site for site in sites}
    if inputs and inputs.get("missing") and time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS + 60 < submit_by:
        questions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for gap in inputs["missing"]:
            if gap.get("site_id") in by_id:
                questions.setdefault(gap["site_id"], []).append(gap.get("fact", ""))
        if questions:
            log(f"[team] following up on {questions}")
            until = time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS
            await asyncio.gather(*(team.follow_up(by_id[site_id], task, the_plan, ledger, asked, until)
                                   for site_id, asked in questions.items()), return_exceptions=True)
            inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by)) or inputs
    if inputs:
        for problem in team.mismatches(inputs):
            log(f"[check] {problem}")
    log(f"[team] calculation inputs: {json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    answer, omitted = compute(inputs, the_plan)
    log(f"[team] answer: {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    target = by_id.get(task["submission"].get("siteId")) or next(
        (by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "tender" and s["site_id"] in by_id),
        sites[0])
    mail = next((by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "mail"
                 and s["site_id"] in by_id), None)
    result = await submit.submit(target, mail, task, answer, omitted, end - 20)
    log(f"[team] submission: {result}")
    return None  # a "site" submission is entered on the website, not returned


def compute(inputs: dict | None, the_plan: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """The answer from the solver's inputs, and the positions left out for lack of facts. Without inputs, an empty
    bid on the planned tender: signed, it still scores its reference and decision."""
    if not inputs:
        return {"tender_reference": the_plan.get("tender_reference", ""), "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR",
                "discount_percent": 0.0, "positions": [], "total_net": 0.0}, []
    answer, steps = calc.compute(inputs)
    for step in steps:
        log(f"[calc] {step}")
    entered = {p["position"] for p in answer["positions"]}
    omitted = [str(p["position"]) for p in inputs.get("positions") or [] if str(p["position"]) not in entered]
    return answer, omitted if answer["decision"] == "bid" else []


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    log(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
        f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}")
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await work(task, await open_sites(playwright, task))
    if answer is None:
        log("No answer to submit through the API")
        return 0
    if not token:
        log(f"Your answer (locally nothing is submitted): {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    log(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}")
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

5	          -> solver (model decides) -> calc.compute (code computes) -> answer
6	"""

9	import time

"""The investigation: one agent per website records facts in a shared ledger, then a solver decides which facts the
rules apply to and hands them to the calculation.

    brief -> plan (model) -> investigators, one per website, in parallel (model-driven browsing) -> ledger
          -> solver (model decides) -> calc.compute (code computes) -> answer
"""
import asyncio
import json
import time

import prompts
import web
from llm import Agent, tool

STRING, NUMBER = {"type": "string"}, {"type": ["string", "number", "null"]}
NULLABLE_STRING = {"type": ["string", "null"]}


class Ledger:
    """Everything the investigators recorded, with where and when; the one place facts come from."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.entries: list[dict] = []

    def add(self, site: str, url: str, topic: str, facts, source: str = "") -> str:
        self.entries.append({"n": len(self.entries) + 1, "site": site, "page": url, "topic": topic,
                             "source": source, "facts": facts, "at": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime())})
        return f"Recorded as #{len(self.entries)}."

    def text(self, topic: str | None = None, exclude_site: str | None = None, limit: int = 200000) -> str:
        entries = [entry for entry in self.entries
                   if (not topic or topic.lower() in json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False).lower())
                   and entry["site"] != exclude_site]
        text = "\n".join(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) for entry in entries)
        return text[-limit:] if text else "Nothing recorded yet."


def record_tools(site: web.Site, ledger: Ledger) -> list:
    async def record(topic: str, facts, source: str = "") -> str:
        return ledger.add(site.id, site.page.url, topic, facts, source)

    async def read_notes(topic: str = "") -> str:
        return ledger.text(topic or None, exclude_site=site.id, limit=30000)

    return [
        (tool("record", "Save facts for the team: copied exactly, with units, dates and identifiers.", {
            "topic": {"type": "string", "description": "What the facts are about, e.g. tender, position, "
                                                       "clarification, requirement, specification revision, mail, "
                                                       "material, price condition, stock"},
            "facts": {"anyOf": [{"type": "object"}, {"type": "array", "items": {}}, {"type": "string"}],
                      "description": "The facts, e.g. an object or a list of table rows"},
            "source": {"type": "string", "description": "Where you saw them: page, document, message"}},
              ["topic", "facts"]), record),
        (tool("read_notes", "Read what the agents on the other websites have recorded so far, optionally only "
                            "records containing a word.", {"topic": {"type": "string"}}), read_notes),
    ]


PLAN_SCHEMA = {
    "tender_reference": {"type": "string", "description": "The tender reference, exactly as in the brief"},
    "bidder_company": STRING, "bidder_vat_id": STRING,
    "scenario_date": {"type": "string", "description": "ISO 8601"},
    "sites": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {
        "site_id": STRING, "kind": {"type": "string", "enum": ["tender", "specification", "erp", "mail", "other"]},
        "holds": {"type": "string", "description": "What the brief says this website holds"}},
        "required": ["site_id", "kind", "holds"]}},
}


async def plan(task: dict, deadline: float) -> dict:
    """The model reads the brief: the identifiers, and which website is which. Code checks the reference."""
    sites = [{"site_id": access.get("siteId"), "url": access["url"]} for access in task["access"]]
    message = f"# The brief\n{task['brief']}\n\n# The websites\n{json.dumps(sites)}\n\nCall finish with the plan."
    for _ in range(2):
        result = await Agent("plan", prompts.PLAN, [], deadline, finish=PLAN_SCHEMA).run(message, max_steps=3) or {}
        if result.get("tender_reference") and result["tender_reference"] in task["brief"]:
            return result
        message += "\n\nThe tender reference must appear in the brief exactly as you write it."
    return result


async def investigate(site: web.Site, task: dict, the_plan: dict, ledger: Ledger, deadline: float,
                      extra: str = "") -> dict | None:
    kind = next((entry for entry in the_plan.get("sites", []) if entry.get("site_id") == site.id), {})
    if kind.get("kind") == "erp":
        extra = prompts.ERP_EXTRA + extra
    elif kind.get("kind") == "mail":
        extra = prompts.MAIL_EXTRA + extra
    first_view = await site.goto(site.url)
    if "password-input" in first_view:  # a login form: the run's credentials go in before the model looks
        first_view = await site.login()
    minutes = max(1, int((deadline - time.time()) / 60))
    agent = Agent(site.id, prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(site) + record_tools(site, ledger), deadline,
                  effort="low", stay_until=deadline - 90)
    return await agent.run(prompts.investigate(task["brief"], site, kind.get("holds", ""),
                                               the_plan.get("tender_reference", ""), minutes, first_view, extra))


async def follow_up(site: web.Site, task: dict, the_plan: dict, ledger: Ledger, questions: list[str],
                    deadline: float) -> dict | None:
    """A short, targeted second look at one website for facts the solver found missing."""
    extra = "\nThe team already has most facts. Find specifically these missing ones:\n" + \
            "\n".join(f"- {question}" for question in questions)
    first_view = await site.view()
    agent = Agent(f"{site.id}+", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(site) + record_tools(site, ledger), deadline,
                  effort="low")
    return await agent.run(prompts.investigate(task["brief"], site, "", the_plan.get("tender_reference", ""),
                                               max(1, int((deadline - time.time()) / 60)), first_view, extra))


EVIDENCE = {"type": "string", "description": "In a few words: which record this is and why it applies"}
POSITION = {"type": "object", "properties": {
    "position": STRING,
    "tender_quantity": NUMBER, "unit": STRING,
    "unit_is_set": {"type": "boolean", "description": "The quantity is in sets and must be converted to pieces"},
    "pieces_per_set": NUMBER,
    "quantity_changes": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {
        "qa_number": STRING, "date": STRING, "quantity": NUMBER}}},
    "withdrawn_qa_numbers": {"type": "array", "items": STRING},
    "requirement": {"type": "object", "description": "After amendments and stroke derivation", "properties": {
        "id": STRING, "catalogue_group": STRING, "bore": STRING, "stroke": STRING, "pressure": STRING,
        "mounting": STRING, "certification": STRING}},
    "material_number": NULLABLE_STRING,
    "material_attributes": {"type": "object", "properties": {
        "status": STRING, "bore": STRING, "stroke": STRING, "pressure": STRING, "mounting": STRING,
        "certification": STRING}},
    "price": {"type": "object", "properties": {
        "valid_from": STRING, "valid_to": STRING, "currency": STRING, "price_unit": NUMBER,
        "scales": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"min_quantity": NUMBER,
                                                                             "price": NUMBER}}},
        "eur_per_currency_unit": NUMBER}},
    "condition_group": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "The condition group a clarification assigned "
                                                                   "to this position, or null"},
    "discount_scope": {"type": "string", "enum": ["base_only", "base_and_surcharge", "none"],
                       "description": "What the condition rules say for the position's group"},
    "surcharge_mass_kg": NUMBER, "setup_fee": NUMBER, "setup_pool_key": NULLABLE_STRING,
    "allocation_mass_kg": NUMBER, "pieces_per_carton": NUMBER, "carton_tariff_eur": NUMBER,
    "stock": NUMBER, "stock_lead_time_weeks": NUMBER, "production_lead_time_weeks": NUMBER,
    "delivery_commitment": {"type": ["object", "null"], "properties": {
        "material_number": STRING, "ceiling_pieces": NUMBER, "lead_time_weeks": NUMBER}},
    "project_bonus_member": {"type": "boolean"}},
    "required": ["position", "tender_quantity", "unit", "material_number"]}

INPUTS_SCHEMA = {
    "tender_reference": STRING,
    "decision": {"type": "string", "enum": ["bid", "no_bid"]},
    "decision_reason": STRING,
    "scenario_date": STRING,
    "discount_approval": {"type": ["object", "null"], "properties": {
        "percent": NUMBER, "min_order_value_eur": NUMBER, "evidence": EVIDENCE}},
    "metal_index": {"type": ["object", "null"], "properties": {
        "rates": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "valid_from": NULLABLE_STRING, "valid_to": NULLABLE_STRING, "eur_per_kg": NUMBER}}},
        "evidence": EVIDENCE}},
    "setup_pools": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {
        "key": STRING, "fee_eur": NUMBER, "evidence": EVIDENCE,
        "allocation": {"type": "string", "enum": ["largest_remainder", "remainder_to_largest_share",
                                                  "remainder_to_first", "remainder_to_last"]}}}},
    "project_bonus": {"type": ["object", "null"], "properties": {
        "bands": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "from_eur": NUMBER, "to_eur": NUMBER, "percent": NUMBER}}},
        "evidence": EVIDENCE}},
    "positions": {"type": "array", "items": POSITION},
    "missing": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"fact": STRING, "site_id": STRING}}},
    "notes": {"type": "string", "description": "At most a few sentences"},
}


async def solve(task: dict, the_plan: dict, ledger: Ledger, deadline: float) -> dict | None:
    agent = Agent("solver", prompts.SOLVER, [], deadline, finish=INPUTS_SCHEMA, effort="medium")
    inputs = await agent.run(prompts.solve(task["brief"], the_plan, ledger.text()), max_steps=4)
    if inputs is not None:
        inputs["tender_reference"] = the_plan.get("tender_reference") or inputs.get("tender_reference")
        inputs.setdefault("scenario_date", the_plan.get("scenario_date"))
        if inputs.get("decision") == "no_bid" and not no_bid_shown(inputs):
            print(f"[team] no_bid without a requirement that has no matching material: bidding instead "
                  f"({inputs.get('decision_reason')})", flush=True)
            inputs["decision"] = "bid"
    return inputs


def no_bid_shown(inputs: dict) -> bool:
    """Rule 3 calls for no_bid only when a position's requirement has no active matching material: that needs a
    position whose requirement is known and which has no material."""
    return any((position.get("requirement") or {}).get("catalogue_group") and not position.get("material_number")
               for position in inputs.get("positions") or [])


def mismatches(inputs: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Positions whose chosen material does not equal the requirement on every attribute the rules name."""
    problems = []
    for position in inputs.get("positions") or []:
        requirement, material = position.get("requirement") or {}, position.get("material_attributes") or {}
        if not position.get("material_number"):
            continue
        for attribute in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification"):
            want, have = _norm(requirement.get(attribute)), _norm(material.get(attribute))
            if want and have and want != have:
                problems.append(f"position {position.get('position')}: {attribute} {have!r} != required {want!r}")
    return problems


def _norm(value) -> str:
    return "".join(str(value or "").lower().replace(",", ".").split()).removesuffix(".0")


async def investigate_all(sites: list[web.Site], task: dict, the_plan: dict, ledger: Ledger, until: float):
    """Every website at once, each agent stopping by `until`; a hard stop shortly after."""
    jobs = [asyncio.create_task(investigate(site, task, the_plan, ledger, until)) for site in sites]
    done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, until - time.time() + 45))
    for job in pending:
        job.cancel()
    for job in done:
        if job.exception():
            print(f"[team] an investigator failed: {job.exception()!r}", flush=True)

3	import json

5	BROWSER = """You are a careful agent preparing a company's bid for a public tender. You operate one web browser on one
6	website through tools, and you decide yourself where to go, what to search for and which records and documents matter.
7	
8	The page is shown to you as text. Numbered elements such as [12 button "Suchen"], [7 input "Name" value=""] or
9	[3 link "Details" → /path] are what you can act on; the numbers change with every view, so use those of the latest
10	one. Frames are shown after the main page. Every action returns the updated page.
11	
12	How to work:
13	- The website is in German and built to trip you up: cookie walls and notices to accept, popups, sliders to drag (drag()),
14	  confirmation checkboxes, codes to copy from one field into another, error pages that need a reload, sessions that expire (call
15	  login, then return to where you were), look-alike records for other references, outdated versions shown first,
16	  paged lists and "load more" buttons, documents in frames or ZIP files, decoy buttons that do nothing. Check after
17	  each action that it did what you meant; if not, try another way.
18	- You are usually logged in already. If a login page appears (a session expired), call login(); it fills in this
19	  website's username and password. Fill any other fields yourself.
20	- fill() enters several fields at once. read_document() reads a linked file or a frame's document as text.
21	- A search runs only once submitted: type(..., enter=true) or click its button, then read the results. If it finds

1	"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
2	agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
3	import re
4	import time
5	
6	import prompts
7	import web
8	from calc import german
9	from llm import Agent, tool
10	
11	
12	def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str]) -> str:
13	    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format."""
14	    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
15	             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
16	             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
17	             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
18	    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
19	        lines.append("| Position | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) | Base price/piece | "
20	                     "Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
21	        for p in answer["positions"]:
22	            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {p['material_number']} | {p['quantity']} | {german(p['unit_price'])} | "
23	                         f"{p['lead_time_weeks']} | {german(p['base_unit_price'])} | "
24	                         f"{german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | {german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | "
25	                         f"{german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
26	        for position in omitted:
27	            lines.append(f"| {position} | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
28	    return "\n".join(lines)
29	
30	
31	def _code(text: str) -> str:
32	    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())
33	
34	
35	async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "") -> str:
36	    first_view = await mail.view()
37	
38	    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
39	        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
40	        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
41	        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
42	            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
43	                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
44	                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
45	        return None
46	
47	    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
48	                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
49	    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), first_view),
50	                             max_steps=25)
51	    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
52	    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
53	        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
54	        return ""
55	    return tan

58	async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
59	                 deadline: float) -> dict | None:
60	    async def get_tan() -> str:
61	        if mail is None:
62	            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
63	        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""))
64	        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."
65	
66	    tools = web.toolbox(site) + [(tool("get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you "
67	                                                  "requested the TAN on this website.", {}), get_tan)]
68	    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
69	              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "

73	        time is left to try again."""
74	        if args.get("status") != "submitted":

76	                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
77	                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
78	            return None

"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
import re
import time

import prompts
import web
from calc import german
from llm import Agent, tool


def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str]) -> str:
    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format."""
    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
        lines.append("| Position | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) | Base price/piece | "
                     "Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
        for p in answer["positions"]:
            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {p['material_number']} | {p['quantity']} | {german(p['unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{p['lead_time_weeks']} | {german(p['base_unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | {german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | "
                         f"{german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
        for position in omitted:
            lines.append(f"| {position} | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _code(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "") -> str:
    first_view = await mail.view()

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan() -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""))
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + [(tool("get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you "
                                                  "requested the TAN on this website.", {}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted), first_view), max_steps=150)

4	OPENAI_API_KEY). Each agent says how much reasoning its job needs: none for operating a form, a little for
5	investigating a website, more for the solver that applies every rule. Tools and reasoning together need OpenAI's
6	Responses API, so that is the one used.
7	
8	An agent is a system prompt, a task and a set of tools. The model picks a tool, the code runs it and returns what
9	happened, until the model calls finish() or its time is up. Old page views are trimmed from the history, so a long
10	investigation stays small and fast.

20	FAST = "gpt-6-luna"  # browsing, forms, the TAN: many small steps
21	STRONG = "gpt-6-sol"  # the solver: one careful reading of all the rules and evidence
22	CALL_SECONDS = 60  # a step that takes longer is asked again
23	KEEP_FULL = 2  # the latest tool results shown in full; older ones are cut to their first lines

31	                              timeout=300, max_retries=1)
32	    return _client

35	async def chat(messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] | None = None, effort: str = "none"):
36	    """One model answer, in the shape of a chat completion; retried on server errors, rate limits and lost
37	    connections. effort is "none", "low" or "medium": medium goes to the strong model."""
38	    request = {"model": STRONG if effort == "medium" else FAST, "input": _items(messages), "store": False,
39	               "reasoning": {"effort": effort},

41	    if tools:

43	    for attempt in range(6):
44	        try:
45	            response = await client().responses.create(**request)
46	            break
47	        except APIStatusError as error:
48	            if error.status_code == 400 and "reasoning" in str(error).lower() and "reasoning" in request:
49	                print(f"[model] {request['model']} refused effort {effort}; asking without it", flush=True)
50	                request.pop("reasoning")
51	                continue
52	            if error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429:
53	                raise

55	        except (APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError) as error:
56	            print(f"[model] {type(error).__name__}, retrying", flush=True)

61	                   for part in item.content if getattr(part, "type", "") == "output_text")

102	    """A model with tools, working on one task until it calls finish() or its deadline passes.

113	        self.functions = {schema["function"]["name"]: function for schema, function in tools}
114	        finish = finish or {"summary": {"type": "string", "description": "What you found or did"}}

121	        idle, stalls, warned = 0, 0, False
122	        while self.steps < max_steps and self.result is None:

143	                print(f"[{self.name}] the model did not answer in time", flush=True)

146	                continue

148	            message = reply.choices[0].message

"""The run contract: read the run (the brief, the websites and their logins, where the answer goes), submit the answer.

In a test run or a scored run the platform sets CHALLENGE_API_URL and CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN. On your own machine there
is no run token: `eval "$(atira scout --env)"` exports the public scouting run as CHALLENGE_SCOUTING instead, and
nothing done with those logins counts. Docs: $API/docs/run-contract.md
"""
import json
import os
import time
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

USER_AGENT = "atira-starter-kit/3"  # the API's edge refuses Python's default urllib agent
LOAD_SCOUTING = 'eval "$(atira scout --env)"; in PowerShell: atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression'


def http(url: str, token: str | None = None, payload: dict | None = None, timeout: float = 30) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """GET (or POST `payload` as JSON) with the run token in x-api-key: the status and the body."""
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": USER_AGENT}
    if token:
        headers["x-api-key"] = token
    data = None
    if payload is not None:
        data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    try:
        with urlopen(Request(url, data=data, headers=headers), timeout=timeout) as response:
            return response.status, response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    except HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def load_run(env=os.environ) -> tuple[dict, str | None]:
    """The run and its token; locally, without a token, the scouting run that `atira scout --env` exported.

    The run has `brief` (the task and its rules, markdown), `access` (per website: `siteId`, `url`, `credentials`),
    `submission` (`kind` "api" or "site", and its `url`), `answer_schema`, `started_at` and `expires_at`.
    """
    token = env.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN")
    if not token:
        if not env.get("CHALLENGE_SCOUTING"):
            raise SystemExit(f"No run token and no scouting logins. To develop locally: {LOAD_SCOUTING}")
        try:
            return json.loads(env["CHALLENGE_SCOUTING"]), None
        except ValueError:
            raise SystemExit(f"CHALLENGE_SCOUTING is not the JSON atira exports. Load it again: {LOAD_SCOUTING}")
    url = env["CHALLENGE_API_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/runs/current"
    status, body = 0, ""
    for attempt in range(5):  # rides out a restart of the API
        try:
            status, body = http(url, token)
        except (URLError, OSError) as error:
            status, body = 0, str(error)
        if status == 200:
            return json.loads(body), token
        if status in (401, 403, 404):  # the run is over, or the token is wrong: no point in asking again
            break
        time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    raise SystemExit(f"Cannot read the run: HTTP {status} {body[:300]}")


def seconds_left(run: dict, now: float | None = None) -> float:
    """Seconds until the run's `expires_at` (epoch milliseconds); after that the answer is refused and the run scores
    0. Every part of the answer scores on its own, so submit your best answer about a minute before time runs out
    rather than keep searching."""
    expires_at = run.get("expires_at")
    if not expires_at:
        return float("inf")
    return expires_at / 1000 - (time.time() if now is None else now)


def submit_answer(run: dict, token: str | None, answer: dict) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """POST the answer to the run's "api" submission target. 202: accepted and final, the run ends. 400: the body
    lists the issues; nothing is recorded, fix the answer and send it again. A "site" submission is entered on that
    website instead, and the website confirms it with a receipt."""
    submission = run["submission"]
    if submission.get("kind") != "api":
        raise ValueError(f"This run takes its answer on the website {submission.get('url')}, not through the API")
    if not token:
        raise ValueError("No run to answer: locally there is no run token. Test it in a run: atira test-run .")
    return http(run.get("answer_url") or submission["url"], token, answer, timeout=60)
