## 8. What went wrong in the first sandbox run (10 Oct, quality 10 of 100)

The run signed a bid on the right tender in 12 minutes: the decision and the reference scored (5 + 5), the TAN step
worked (the submitter passed the request number, the TAN reader opened exactly that mail). Everything else scored 0,
because **every position was left out**.

| What went wrong | Why | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| The ERP agent gave up in the first minutes | It started before the specification agent had recorded the catalogue groups, tried a generic search word (which lists nothing) and called finish; it was sent back twice, then allowed to stop | `wait_for_notes()` tool: it waits for the requirements instead of finishing; up to 6 refusals for the ERP agent; prompt: generic words list nothing, the catalogue groups are the keys |
| Only one of four materials found, without a price | When the groups arrived (about minute 5) the ERP agent had too little time left | investigation runs until 10:30 instead of 9:00 |
| The follow-up round never ran | The solver finished around minute 10:30; the follow-up needed 160 s before the bid form had to start at minute 12 | the bid form starts at minute 14 at the latest (the empty form and TAN took about a minute; a full one about four); the follow-up is 75 s with a 30 s margin |
| All five positions omitted | `calc.py` dropped every position without a valid price | a position with a known material and quantity is entered at unit price 0: material, quantity and lead time still score (45 % of each position) |
| Discount 0 instead of the approved percentage | With no prices, the order value was 0 and failed the approval's minimum order value | with prices missing, the order value is unknown and the approved percentage is used |
| Q&A dates not recorded | Hidden behind a receipt marker per answer (section 2) | prompt: click the control that reveals a missing date |
| A model call after the submission failed with "expired run token" | Submitting ends the run, the proxy then refuses calls | harmless; the bid was already signed |

## 9. Testing notes

| Final confirmation | A native browser confirm dialog | code: dialogs are accepted automatically (`page.on("dialog")`) |

This run also proved the signing works end to end: the bid was signed with the right TAN in 12 minutes.

## 9. Seen in the second sandbox run (with the fixes from section 8)

| Observation | Risk | Next fix |
|---|---|---|
| The ERP agent used `wait_for_notes("requirement")` and started searching as soon as the first catalogue group arrived | – (the fix works) | – |
| The mail agent finished after recording only the discount approvals; refused twice, the third finish was accepted | Condition rules, index, technical release (end reserves!), packaging, delivery, FX, bonus, setup pool all missing | more refusals for every investigator, and a check of what each site's agent recorded against the fact list before accepting finish |
| Model calls of more than 60 s ("the model did not answer in time") on several agents | Three stalls in a row stop an agent; slow calls eat the 20 minutes | measure call latency per run; fall back to a second model or a shorter prompt when calls stall |
| The spec agent first named the superseded revision as current (it read the status column wrong, next to a "release status" button), recorded its requirements, then corrected itself in a later record | The solver gets contradictory records; the wrong revision changes strokes and makes materials not match | solver prompt: a later explicit correction replaces earlier records; recording revisions as one table (number, date, status) before any requirement |
| The ERP agent collected everything (stock, prices, lead times) for a **blocked** candidate before looking at the active one | Wasted minutes on a material that can never qualify | ERP prompt: read the status first, skip conditions and stock of blocked candidates |
| Q&A dates were recorded for some answers after the date-reveal hint, not all | Quantity changes without dates fall back to answer numbers, which are not chronological | check in code: a quantity change without a date is flagged to the solver |
| The CLI timed out on upload, but the run had been created on the server | Retrying blindly starts a duplicate run | before retrying `atira test-run`, check `atira status` for a new run with our package size |
| A run ended after 33 s with "The platform failed, not your agent system. This run doesn't count" | – (platform side) | start it again |

## 10. Watch list for the private dataset

The private run uses other software, layouts, site names and data, and splits the facts differently across the
sites. Everything that worked here because of how the public sites happen to look is fragile:

- **Which site holds which fact is not fixed.** The specification could be in the ERP or arrive by mail, the Q&A
  could sit in a document, approvals could be in a portal. The plan step names site kinds from the brief; the
  investigators must record every fact type they meet, not only "their" kind.
- **Gates will look different.** Other unlock widgets, other receipt or reference codes to copy, terms in another
  wording. The prompts describe gates by purpose, not by label; keep it that way.
- **Decoys will be different.** A hidden value, a preview box, a look-alike record, a future-dated record, a
  superseded revision shown first: expect the same kinds in new disguises.
- **Search may not be by catalogue group.** It could be by attributes, a material class or free text with filters.
  `wait_for_notes("requirement")` assumes the ERP depends on requirements from another site; on the private data the
  dependency could run the other way.
- **Number, date and unit formats will differ.** Locale tags may be missing; prices per 1000 or per carton; masses in
  kg; dates with month names. `calc.dec` only knows "(en-US)" and "(de-DE)" tags.
- **The TAN may arrive elsewhere** (another mailbox, a page, a document) with another way of naming the request.
- **The bid form will differ.** Other steps, other order, other preselected traps, another declaration that adds
  terms. The submitter follows the brief's submission section; nothing in code names a form field.
- **No-bid may be the right answer.** One requirement with no active match means no_bid; it has not been tested end
  to end yet.

## 11. Generalization backlog (after the public run reaches 100)

- Grep the package for anything public-specific (values, labels, URL paths); today: none.
- Replace the remaining public-shaped assumptions: the "erp" special case for refusals, the "requirement" topic in the
  ERP prompt, the fixed site kinds in the plan schema.
- Make the fact checklist explicit in code (from the brief's rules) and let each investigator see which facts are
  still missing team-wide, instead of each agent deciding alone when it is done.
- Parallelize per-requirement ERP lookups (several tabs) once the groups are known.
- Test a no_bid scenario and a scenario where facts sit on unexpected sites, with made-up pages.
- Speed and cost only after quality is flat: smaller views, fewer screenshots, cheaper model for form filling.

## 12. Testing notes

Done, and it's all in [PITFALLS.md](PITFALLS.md). It's generic, with no public values, so it's safe to commit. New since your request:

- **Section 9, observations from run #2:**
  - investigators quitting too early (the mail agent after 2 records)
  - OpenAI calls stalling over 60 s
  - the wrong current revision (its status hides behind a button in each row, the same pattern as the Q&A dates)
  - the ERP agent researching a blocked material in full
  - only some Q&A dates captured
  - CLI upload timeouts that silently create runs (so check before retrying)
  - platform-side failures
- **Section 10, watch list for the private dataset.** These are things that only worked because of how the public sites look:
  - facts sitting on different sites
  - different gates, decoys and search methods
  - other number, date and unit formats
  - the TAN arriving elsewhere
  - a different bid form
  - no_bid, which hasn't been tested end to end yet
- **Section 11, generalization backlog** for after you reach 100:
  - remove the remaining public-shaped assumptions (the ERP special case, the "requirement" topic, fixed site kinds)
  - a team-wide checklist of missing facts
  - parallel ERP lookups
  - tests with made-up no_bid and unusual-layout pages
  - speed and cost last

I also turned the "value hidden behind a button" pattern into a general rule in the agents' instructions: click the control next to a record, never guess a date or status. That applies from the next run; run #2 is still going with the old prompts, and I'm still watching it.

So one timed-out upload created two runs, and my retry added a third. That's my mistake: I only checked the list for a failed run before retrying, not for a running one. The PITFALLS lesson gets sharpened accordingly: after a timeout, check *all* new runs before retrying.

Run #2b (`1c07`) has finished with **quality 10, the same as run #1**. The bid was signed (decision + reference = 10, TAN worked again), but all positions were empty. This time all 5 quantities were right, but no materials were known, so every position was left out. It cost about $0.26.

3. **Keep the approved discount when no prices are known**: +5 points. This run got 0% because the empty order failed the €1 minimum.

lines = []
    for position in sorted(inputs.get("positions") or [], key=lambda p: position_key(p["position"])):
        quantity = final_quantity(position)
        base = scale_price(position.get("price") or {}, quantity) if quantity else None
        if not position.get("material_number") or not quantity:
            log.append(f"position {position['position']}: omitted (material {position.get('material_number')}, "
                       f"quantity {quantity})")
            continue
        # without a valid price the position is still entered (at a unit price of zero): its material, quantity
        # and lead time score on their own, an omitted position scores nothing
        lines.append({**position, "quantity": quantity, "base": base})
        log.append(f"position {position['position']}: {quantity} pieces of {position['material_number']}, "
                   f"base {base} EUR" + ("" if base is not None else " (no valid price found: unit price 0)"))
    priced = [line for line in lines if line["base"] is not None]

    # "Conditional discount": the undiscounted net order value against the approval's inclusive threshold. With
    # prices missing the value is unknown, and the approved percentage is the best estimate.
    order_value = money(sum((line["base"] * line["quantity"] for line in priced), ZERO))
    threshold = dec(approval.get("min_order_value_eur"))
    if threshold is None or order_value >= threshold or len(priced) < len(lines):
        discount = percent
    else:
        discount = ZERO
    log.append(f"discount {discount} % (approved {percent} %, threshold {threshold}, order value {order_value}"
               f"{'' if len(priced) == len(lines) else ', some prices missing'})")
    rate = 1 - discount / 100

    metal = metal_rate(inputs.get("metal_index"), scenario_day)
    log.append(f"metal rate {metal} EUR/kg on {scenario_day}")

def lead_time(line: dict, demand: dict[str, int]) -> int:
    """Rule 6, "shared stock" and "delivery": a matching commitment within its ceiling, else stock delivery when stock
    covers the whole pooled demand for the material, else production."""
    pooled = demand[line["material_number"]]
    commitment = line.get("delivery_commitment") or {}
    ceiling = dec(commitment.get("ceiling_pieces"))
    if (commitment.get("lead_time_weeks") is not None and commitment.get("material_number") == line["material_number"]
            and (ceiling is None or pooled <= ceiling)):
        return int(commitment["lead_time_weeks"])
    stock = dec(line.get("stock"))
    if stock is not None and stock >= pooled and line.get("stock_lead_time_weeks") is not None:
        return int(line["stock_lead_time_weeks"])
    weeks = line.get("production_lead_time_weeks")
    if weeks is None:
        weeks = line.get("stock_lead_time_weeks") or 0
    return int(weeks)

"""The entry point (agent.json runs it): the team of agents on the run's clock.

    plan the task from the brief (model)
    investigate every website at once, one agent and one browser each (models navigate and record)
    decide which facts apply (model), then compute the bid (calc.py, exact decimals)
    enter and sign the bid on the submission website (model operates the form, a second agent reads the TAN)

The whole run is bounded by its 20 minutes: investigation stops at INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, the solver has SOLVE_SECONDS,
and the submission starts no later than SUBMIT_RESERVE before the end, whatever is still missing. A partial bid scores; a late one does not.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import calc
import run as contract
import submit
import team
import web

RUN_SECONDS = 20 * 60
INVESTIGATE_UNTIL = 10 * 60 + 30  # seconds from the start
SOLVE_SECONDS = 150
# entering and signing the bid starts no later than this before the end: a full form (every position through its
# configurator) and the TAN take about four minutes
SUBMIT_RESERVE = 6 * 60
FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS = 75


def log(text: str):
    print(text, flush=True)


async def open_sites(playwright, task: dict) -> list[web.Site]:
    """One browser per website: the run's browsers (up to 4), or locally a Chromium each."""
    available = len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or len(task["access"])
    sites, browser = [], None
    for number, access in enumerate(task["access"]):
        if number < available:
            browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
            context = page.context
        else:  # more websites than browsers: a context of its own in the last one
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
        sites.append(web.Site(access, context, page, log))
    return sites


async def work(task: dict, sites: list[web.Site]) -> dict | None:
    start = time.time()
    end = min(start + RUN_SECONDS, task["expires_at"] / 1000) if task.get("expires_at") else start + RUN_SECONDS
    submit_by = end - SUBMIT_RESERVE

    the_plan = await team.plan(task, start + 120)
    log(f"[team] plan: {json.dumps(the_plan, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    ledger = team.Ledger()
    await team.investigate_all(sites, task, the_plan, ledger, min(start + INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, submit_by - SOLVE_SECONDS))
    log(f"[team] {len(ledger.entries)} records after investigating:")
    for entry in ledger.entries:
        log(f"  {json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}")

    inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by))
    by_id = {site.id: site for site in sites}
    if inputs and inputs.get("missing") and time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS + 30 < submit_by:
        questions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for gap in inputs["missing"]:
            if gap.get("site_id") in by_id:
                questions.setdefault(gap["site_id"], []).append(gap.get("fact", ""))
        if questions:
            log(f"[team] following up on {questions}")
            until = time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS
            await asyncio.gather(*(team.follow_up(by_id[site_id], task, the_plan, ledger, asked, until)
                                   for site_id, asked in questions.items()), return_exceptions=True)
            inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by)) or inputs
    if inputs:
        for problem in team.mismatches(inputs):
            log(f"[check] {problem}")
    log(f"[team] calculation inputs: {json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    answer, omitted = compute(inputs, the_plan)
    log(f"[team] answer: {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    target = by_id.get(task["submission"].get("siteId")) or next(
        (by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "tender" and s["site_id"] in by_id),
        sites[0])
    mail = next((by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "mail"
                 and s["site_id"] in by_id), None)
    result = await submit.submit(target, mail, task, answer, omitted, end - 20)
    log(f"[team] submission: {result}")
    return None  # a "site" submission is entered on the website, not returned


def compute(inputs: dict | None, the_plan: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """The answer from the solver's inputs, and the positions left out for lack of facts. Without inputs, an empty

"""The entry point (agent.json runs it): the team of agents on the run's clock.

    plan the task from the brief (model)
    investigate every website at once, one agent and one browser each (models navigate and record)
    decide which facts apply (model), then compute the bid (calc.py, exact decimals)
    enter and sign the bid on the submission website (model operates the form, a second agent reads the TAN)

The whole run is bounded by its 20 minutes: investigation stops at INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, the solver has SOLVE_SECONDS,
and the submission starts no later than SUBMIT_RESERVE before the end, whatever is still missing. A partial bid scores; a late one does not.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import calc
import run as contract
import submit
import team
import web

RUN_SECONDS = 20 * 60
INVESTIGATE_UNTIL = 10 * 60 + 30  # seconds from the start
SOLVE_SECONDS = 150
# entering and signing the bid starts no later than this before the end: a full form (every position through its
# configurator) and the TAN take about four minutes
SUBMIT_RESERVE = 6 * 60
FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS = 75


def log(text: str):
    print(text, flush=True)


async def open_sites(playwright, task: dict) -> list[web.Site]:
    """One browser per website: the run's browsers (up to 4), or locally a Chromium each."""
    available = len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or len(task["access"])
    sites, browser = [], None
    for number, access in enumerate(task["access"]):
        if number < available:
            browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
            context = page.context
        else:  # more websites than browsers: a context of its own in the last one
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
        sites.append(web.Site(access, context, page, log))
    return sites


async def work(task: dict, sites: list[web.Site]) -> dict | None:
    start = time.time()
    end = min(start + RUN_SECONDS, task["expires_at"] / 1000) if task.get("expires_at") else start + RUN_SECONDS
    submit_by = end - SUBMIT_RESERVE

    the_plan = await team.plan(task, start + 120)
    log(f"[team] plan: {json.dumps(the_plan, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    ledger = team.Ledger()
    await team.investigate_all(sites, task, the_plan, ledger, min(start + INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, submit_by - SOLVE_SECONDS))
    log(f"[team] {len(ledger.entries)} records after investigating:")
    for entry in ledger.entries:
        log(f"  {json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}")

    inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by))
    by_id = {site.id: site for site in sites}
    if inputs and inputs.get("missing") and time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS + 30 < submit_by:
        questions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for gap in inputs["missing"]:
            if gap.get("site_id") in by_id:
                questions.setdefault(gap["site_id"], []).append(gap.get("fact", ""))
        if questions:
            log(f"[team] following up on {questions}")
            until = time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS
            await asyncio.gather(*(team.follow_up(by_id[site_id], task, the_plan, ledger, asked, until)
                                   for site_id, asked in questions.items()), return_exceptions=True)
            inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by)) or inputs
    if inputs:
        for problem in team.mismatches(inputs):
            log(f"[check] {problem}")
    log(f"[team] calculation inputs: {json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    answer, omitted = compute(inputs, the_plan)
    log(f"[team] answer: {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    target = by_id.get(task["submission"].get("siteId")) or next(
        (by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "tender" and s["site_id"] in by_id),
        sites[0])
    mail = next((by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "mail"
                 and s["site_id"] in by_id), None)
    result = await submit.submit(target, mail, task, answer, omitted, end - 20, configurator_values(inputs))
    log(f"[team] submission: {result}")
    return None  # a "site" submission is entered on the website, not returned


def compute(inputs: dict | None, the_plan: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """The answer from the solver's inputs, and the positions left out for lack of facts. Without inputs, an empty
    bid on the planned tender: signed, it still scores its reference and decision."""
    if not inputs:
        return {"tender_reference": the_plan.get("tender_reference", ""), "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR",
                "discount_percent": 0.0, "positions": [], "total_net": 0.0}, []
    answer, steps = calc.compute(inputs)
    for step in steps:
        log(f"[calc] {step}")
    entered = {p["position"] for p in answer["positions"]}
    omitted = [str(p["position"]) for p in inputs.get("positions") or [] if str(p["position"]) not in entered]
    return answer, omitted if answer["decision"] == "bid" else []


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    log(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
        f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}")
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await work(task, await open_sites(playwright, task))
    if answer is None:
        log("No answer to submit through the API")
        return 0
    if not token:
        log(f"Your answer (locally nothing is submitted): {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    log(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}")
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
import re
import time

import prompts
import web
from calc import german
from llm import Agent, tool


def _german(value) -> str:
    """A value in the form's number format; an unknown one is left empty."""
    return "(leave empty)" if value is None else german(value)


def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str]) -> str:
    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format."""
    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
        lines.append("| Position | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) | Base price/piece | "
                     "Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
        for p in answer["positions"]:
            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {p['material_number']} | {p['quantity']} | {_german(p['unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{p['lead_time_weeks']} | {_german(p['base_unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{_german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | {_german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | "
                         f"{_german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
        for position in omitted:
            lines.append(f"| {position} | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _code(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "",
                    request: str = "") -> str:
    """The TAN from the mailbox: the message for `request` (the number the submission website gave the request),
    else the newest TAN message."""
    first_view = await mail.view()

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), request, first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan(request: str = "") -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""), request)
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + [(tool(
        "get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you requested the TAN on this website, "
                   "with the request number or identifier the website showed for your request, so that the TAN of "
                   "exactly this request is used.",
        {"request": {"type": "string", "description": "The number the website gave your TAN request, copied from "
                                                      "the page (empty if it showed none)"}}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted), first_view), max_steps=150)

content.text:
It **is** working; the stream just looks worse than it is. Every "finish" line you're seeing is an agent *trying* to stop. The new rule refuses those attempts and sends the agent back, so you see lots of "finish" messages but the work continues. From the log:

- **Tender portal:** it got lost for a moment. It clicked the "ask a new question" link and landed in a question form (a trap), then said it was stuck. The refusal sent it back: it re-opened the tender, recorded the positions, and is now **recording the Q&A answers with their dates**, e.g. answer 3916 dated 16.01. In run #1 it never got those dates. So it's doing better than before, just with a detour.
- **Spec agent:** done, and correct this time (R-6156 current; R-4034 and R-9711 replaced).
- **Mail:** better than run #2 but still incomplete. It now has the discount approval, the setup pool rule and the delivery commitments, but not yet the condition rules, price index, technical release, packaging, exchange rate or bonus. It keeps trying to stop and is being sent back.
- **ERP:** slow. A model call stalled, and it again started with the blocked material HZ-8405.

Two fixes for later: block the "ask a new question" link as a dead end in the prompt, and make the mail agent go through its topic list instead of deciding on its own when it's done.

content.text:
I can see what's going wrong, and it's a risk for this run. The bid is computed: 01.01 has a real price (€2,608.10, lead time 2 weeks) and every other position is entered. But the **submitter is struggling with the configurator** on its first position (01.04):
- It sets all 4 values at once with one "fill", or sets the stroke before the bore has been applied.
- The configurator only unlocks the next field after each "Auswahl übernehmen" (apply), so the field it wants is still locked.
- So it keeps re-filling and re-applying, says "failed", gets sent back, and has now moved on to 01.02 (63/500).

**The danger:** if it can't get through all 5 positions before the deadline, there's no signed bid at all, and that scores 0, worse than run #2. Nothing in the code currently makes it skip to the signature when time runs short.

For the next round, two fixes, because the form is where the points are now lost:
1. **A time guard in code:** with about 3 minutes left, the submitter must omit the unfinished positions and sign. A partial signed bid always beats an unsigned one.
2. **Configurator help in code:** apply one choice at a time automatically (choose a value, click apply, wait for the next field). The model then only picks values, and the fill tool reports clearly when a field is still locked.

I'm watching whether it reaches the TAN in time.

content.text:
It's slow because the bid form is now doing real work, and doing it inefficiently:

1. **The configurator needs a page reload per choice.** That's 4 choices (bore, stroke, mounting, certification), each followed by "apply" and a reload, then the material, 6 price fields, lead time and "Weiter", for each of 5 positions. Every action is one model call, so that's about 60–70 model calls for the form alone. In runs #1 and #2 the form went quickly because every position was skipped.
2. **The model wastes steps.** It fills several configurator fields at once or out of order. The next field only unlocks after "apply", so it repeats itself and calls "failed", which gets refused and costs yet another call.
3. **The model is slow right now.** Several calls took over 60 seconds ("did not answer in time") and had to be asked again.
4. **Every step sends the whole page again** (up to 16,000 characters), which makes each call slower.

**Fix for the next round:** a **configurator helper in code**. The model calls one tool per position with the values in order. The code picks each value, clicks apply, waits for the next field, and finally selects the material. That turns about 12 model calls per position into 1–2. Together with the **time guard** (with about 3 minutes left: omit what's unfinished and sign), the form should take about 2 minutes and never block the signature.

async def _pick(self, script: str, argument: str):
        """The first frame where `script` finds and marks an element: (frame, what it reported)."""
        page = await self._active()
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                found = await frame.evaluate(script, argument)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if found:
                return frame, found
        return None, None

    async def configure(self, steps: list[dict], apply: str = "") -> str:
        """Choices that unlock one another (a configurator): each step selects a value in the field with that label,
        then clicks the `apply` button (except after the last step, or where a step says "apply": false) and waits
        for the next field to open. Stops at the first step that cannot be done and says why."""
        done: list[str] = []
        for number, step in enumerate(steps):
            field, value = str(step.get("field", "")), str(step.get("value", ""))
            frame, found = None, None

"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
import re
import time

import prompts
import web
from calc import german
from llm import Agent, tool


def _german(value) -> str:
    """A value in the form's number format; an unknown one is left empty."""
    return "(leave empty)" if value is None else german(value)


def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str], configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> str:
    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format, and per position
    the attribute values a material configurator asks for before it offers the materials."""
    configurator = configurator or {}
    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
        lines.append("| Position | Configurator values | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) "
                     "| Base price/piece | Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
        for p in answer["positions"]:
            values = configurator.get(str(p["position"])) or {}
            shown = " / ".join(f"{key} {value}" for key, value in values.items()) or "(see the requirement)"
            material = p["material_number"] or "(choose: the material the configurator offers for these values)"
            weeks = p["lead_time_weeks"] if p["lead_time_weeks"] is not None else "(unknown: choose any)"
            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {shown} | {material} | {p['quantity']} | {_german(p['unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{weeks} | {_german(p['base_unit_price'])} | {_german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | "
                         f"{_german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | {_german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
        for position in omitted:
            lines.append(f"| {position} | | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _code(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "",
                    request: str = "") -> str:
    """The TAN from the mailbox: the message for `request` (the number the submission website gave the request),
    else the newest TAN message."""
    first_view = await mail.view()

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), request, first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float, configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan(request: str = "") -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""), request)
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + [(tool(
        "get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you requested the TAN on this website, "
                   "with the request number or identifier the website showed for your request, so that the TAN of "
                   "exactly this request is used.",
        {"request": {"type": "string", "description": "The number the website gave your TAN request, copied from "
                                                      "the page (empty if it showed none)"}}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted, configurator), first_view), max_steps=150)

"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
import re
import time

import prompts
import web
from calc import german
from llm import Agent, tool


def _german(value) -> str:
    """A value in the form's number format; an unknown one is left empty."""
    return "(leave empty)" if value is None else german(value)


def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str], configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> str:
    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format, and per position
    the attribute values a material configurator asks for before it offers the materials."""
    configurator = configurator or {}
    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
        lines.append("| Position | Configurator values | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) "
                     "| Base price/piece | Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
        for p in answer["positions"]:
            values = configurator.get(str(p["position"])) or {}
            shown = " / ".join(f"{key} {value}" for key, value in values.items()) or "(see the requirement)"
            material = p["material_number"] or "(choose: the material the configurator offers for these values)"
            weeks = p["lead_time_weeks"] if p["lead_time_weeks"] is not None else "(unknown: choose any)"
            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {shown} | {material} | {p['quantity']} | {_german(p['unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{weeks} | {_german(p['base_unit_price'])} | {_german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | "
                         f"{_german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | {_german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
        for position in omitted:
            lines.append(f"| {position} | | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _code(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "",
                    request: str = "") -> str:
    """The TAN from the mailbox: the message for `request` (the number the submission website gave the request),
    else the newest TAN message."""
    first_view = await mail.view()

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), request, first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float, configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan(request: str = "") -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""), request)
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + web.configure_tool(site) + [(tool(
        "get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you requested the TAN on this website, "
                   "with the request number or identifier the website showed for your request, so that the TAN of "
                   "exactly this request is used.",
        {"request": {"type": "string", "description": "The number the website gave your TAN request, copied from "
                                                      "the page (empty if it showed none)"}}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted, configurator), first_view), max_steps=150)

That isn't me. I'm not controlling any browser right now: my Chrome tabs are closed and the Chrome extension is disconnected. All I'm doing is reading the sandbox run's log.

If you're watching the run's **live view**, the highlighting comes from **our agent's browsers** in the sandbox, for two harmless reasons:
1. **Slider drags.** For the "drag to unlock" sliders, the agent presses the mouse and moves it to the right. If the press lands next to the slider handle instead of on it, the browser treats the movement as selecting text, so the text gets highlighted. That also means the drag missed, and the agent has to try again.
2. **Filling fields.** Before typing into a field, Playwright selects whatever is already in it, so the field's text flashes highlighted for a moment.

The first one costs a few steps, so I'll note it as a small improvement for later. If you're seeing the highlighting somewhere else, tell me where and I'll look.

content.text:
The mail agent **froze inside our own code, before its model ever took a step**. The log shows:
1. The agent opened the mailbox, and our code logged in automatically (username, password, Enter).
2. Our code then reads the page to show it to the model for the first time.
3. **That read never returned.** The log has no single `[mail]` action, not even a first look.

**Why that kills the agent:** reading the page means running a script inside the page, and that call has **no timeout**. If the page doesn't respond to scripts, our code waits forever. I saw exactly this on a mail page in my manual session: a message tab stopped answering scripts while still displaying fine. It doesn't happen every time; the mail agent worked in runs #1–#3. That's why it's dangerous: one stuck page silently takes out a whole agent and every fact it would have found (here: the discount, condition rules, technical release, tariffs and so on).

**The fix (first on the list for the next round):**
- **A timeout on reading each frame** (about 10–15 s). A frame that doesn't answer is reported as "this frame is not responding", and the rest of the page is still shown.
- **A timeout on every tool call** (about 60–90 s). If a click or page read hangs, the model gets "the action timed out, reload the page" and carries on, instead of the agent stopping silently.
- **A watchdog in the team code.** If an investigator records nothing for several minutes, restart it on a fresh tab.

The platform's API is busy right now (503), so I can't see whether the mail browser has recovered.

**With the current code: no.** If the mail browser stays frozen, the TAN can't be read:
- The TAN reader uses **the same mail browser** as the mail investigator. Its first step reads the current page, which is the frozen one, and that read has no timeout.
- `get_tan` would then hang, the submitter would wait on it, and the bid would **never be signed**. That scores 0, since only a signed bid counts.

It only works if the mail page has recovered in the meantime. Sometimes a stuck page does recover, e.g. after the investigation task was cancelled.

**What I'll change so this can't happen again:**
1. **The TAN reader opens a fresh tab** in the mail browser. The login session is shared, so no new login is needed, and it no longer depends on a page some other agent left behind.
2. **Timeouts on every page read and tool call**, plus a retry. A frozen page means "open a new tab and try again", not a silent hang.
3. **A timeout around the follow-up round**, so a stuck follow-up can never block the submission.

"""The submission: an agent enters the computed bid on the submission website and signs it with a TAN that a second
agent reads from the mailbox. The values come from calc; the model only operates the form."""
import re
import time

import prompts
import web
from calc import german
from llm import Agent, tool


def _german(value) -> str:
    """A value in the form's number format; an unknown one is left empty."""
    return "(leave empty)" if value is None else german(value)


def table(answer: dict, omitted: list[str], configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> str:
    """The bid as the submitter sees it: every value already in the form's German number format, and per position
    the attribute values a material configurator asks for before it offers the materials."""
    configurator = configurator or {}
    lines = [f"Tender reference: {answer['tender_reference']}",
             f"Decision: {answer['decision']} ({'main bid' if answer['decision'] == 'bid' else 'declaration of no bid'})",
             f"Currency: EUR", f"Discount percent: {german(answer['discount_percent'])}",
             f"Total net (EUR): {german(answer['total_net'])}", ""]
    if answer["decision"] == "bid":
        lines.append("| Position | Configurator values | Material | Quantity (pieces) | Unit price net | Lead time (weeks) "
                     "| Base price/piece | Surcharge/piece | Packaging/piece | Project bonus (whole position) |")
        for p in answer["positions"]:
            values = configurator.get(str(p["position"])) or {}
            shown = " / ".join(f"{key} {value}" for key, value in values.items()) or "(see the requirement)"
            material = p["material_number"] or "(choose: the material the configurator offers for these values)"
            weeks = p["lead_time_weeks"] if p["lead_time_weeks"] is not None else "(unknown: choose any)"
            lines.append(f"| {p['position']} | {shown} | {material} | {p['quantity']} | {_german(p['unit_price'])} | "
                         f"{weeks} | {_german(p['base_unit_price'])} | {_german(p['surcharge_per_unit'])} | "
                         f"{_german(p['packaging_per_unit'])} | {_german(p['rebate_total'])} |")
        for position in omitted:
            lines.append(f"| {position} | | OMIT | | | | | | | |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _code(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "",
                    request: str = "") -> str:
    """The TAN from the mailbox: the message for `request` (the number the submission website gave the request),
    else the newest TAN message."""
    first_view = await mail.view()

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), request, first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float, configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan(request: str = "") -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""), request)
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + web.configure_tool(site) + [(tool(
        "get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you requested the TAN on this website, "
                   "with the request number or identifier the website showed for your request, so that the TAN of "
                   "exactly this request is used.",
        {"request": {"type": "string", "description": "The number the website gave your TAN request, copied from "
                                                      "the page (empty if it showed none)"}}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    # a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned one does not: well before the end, the rest is omitted and signed
    wrap_up = ("Less than three minutes are left. Stop entering positions now: omit every position you have not "
               "entered yet (with the form's option to omit a position), then go straight on: declarations, "
               "request the TAN, get_tan(request=...), enter it and confirm the bid. A signed partial bid scores; "
               "an unsigned one scores nothing.")
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed,
                  warn_at=deadline - 180, warning=wrap_up)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted, configurator), first_view), max_steps=150)

    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-z]", "", str(text).lower())


async def fetch_tan(mail: web.Site, requested_at: float, deadline: float, reference: str = "",
                    request: str = "") -> str:
    """The TAN from the mailbox: the message for `request` (the number the submission website gave the request),
    else the newest TAN message. It starts in a fresh tab: the page the mail investigator left can be stuck."""
    try:
        first_view = await asyncio.wait_for(mail.fresh_tab(), 45)
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"[tan] a fresh mailbox tab failed ({type(error).__name__}); using the open one", flush=True)
        first_view = await asyncio.wait_for(mail.view(), 30)

    async def real_tan(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """A TAN is a code of its own: not empty, not a word like "unknown", not the tender reference."""
        tan = _code(args.get("tan", ""))
        if len(tan) < 4 or not re.search(r"\d", tan) or (reference and tan in _code(reference)):
            return ("That is not a TAN: copy the code itself from the message text (it is neither the tender "
                    "reference nor the request number in the subject). Open the message, unlock it, open its "
                    "original text, or call screenshot() to see it.")
        return None

    agent = Agent("tan", prompts.BROWSER, web.toolbox(mail), deadline, check=real_tan,
                  finish={"tan": {"type": "string", "description": "The TAN exactly as written in the message"}})
    result = await agent.run(prompts.tan(time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime(requested_at)), request, first_view),
                             max_steps=25)
    tan = (result or {}).get("tan", "")
    if await real_tan({"tan": tan}):  # for the run's log: what the mailbox showed instead
        print(f"[tan] no TAN found; the mailbox page was:\n{mail.full_view[:4000]}", flush=True)
        return ""
    return tan


async def submit(site: web.Site, mail: web.Site | None, task: dict, answer: dict, omitted: list[str],
                 deadline: float, configurator: dict[str, dict] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    async def get_tan(request: str = "") -> str:
        if mail is None:
            return "No mailbox website is known; look for the TAN where the brief says it arrives."
        tan = await fetch_tan(mail, time.time(), time.time() + 120, answer.get("tender_reference", ""), request)
        return f"The TAN is {tan}" if tan else "No TAN message was found yet; call get_tan() again in a moment."

    tools = web.toolbox(site) + web.configure_tool(site) + [(tool(
        "get_tan", "Read the signing TAN from the mailbox. Call it right after you requested the TAN on this website, "
                   "with the request number or identifier the website showed for your request, so that the TAN of "
                   "exactly this request is used.",
        {"request": {"type": "string", "description": "The number the website gave your TAN request, copied from "
                                                      "the page (empty if it showed none)"}}), get_tan)]
    finish = {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["submitted", "failed"]},
              "receipt": {"type": "string", "description": "The website's confirmation text, copied exactly from "
                                                        "the page (e.g. its receipt number line)"}}
    async def confirmed(args: dict) -> str | None:
        """"submitted" counts only when the confirmation the agent quotes is on the page; "failed" only when no
        time is left to try again."""
        if args.get("status") != "submitted":
            if deadline - time.time() > 90:
                return ("Do not give up: there is still time. If the TAN failed, request a new TAN on this website "
                        "and call get_tan() again; if a step failed, look at the page and continue from where it is.")
            return None
        await site.view()
        quoted = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args.get("receipt", "")).strip().lower()
        page_text = re.sub(r"\[\d+ [^\]]*\]", " ", site.full_view)  # without buttons, links and fields
        if len(quoted) < 6 or quoted not in re.sub(r"\s+", " ", page_text).lower():
            return ("The page does not show that as a confirmation (a button or link label does not count). The bid "
                    "is only submitted once the website confirms it: complete the remaining steps (TAN, final "
                    "confirmation), then quote the confirmation text exactly.")
        return None

    first_view = await site.view()
    # a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned one does not: well before the end, the rest is omitted and signed
    wrap_up = ("Less than three minutes are left. Stop entering positions now: omit every position you have not "
               "entered yet (with the form's option to omit a position), then go straight on: declarations, "
               "request the TAN, get_tan(request=...), enter it and confirm the bid. A signed partial bid scores; "
               "an unsigned one scores nothing.")
    agent = Agent("submit", prompts.BROWSER, tools, deadline, finish=finish, check=confirmed,
                  warn_at=deadline - 180, warning=wrap_up)
    return await agent.run(prompts.submit(task["brief"], table(answer, omitted, configurator), first_view), max_steps=150)

"""The entry point (agent.json runs it): the team of agents on the run's clock.

    plan the task from the brief (model)
    investigate every website at once, one agent and one browser each (models navigate and record)
    decide which facts apply (model), then compute the bid (calc.py, exact decimals)
    enter and sign the bid on the submission website (model operates the form, a second agent reads the TAN)

The whole run is bounded by its 20 minutes: investigation stops at INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, the solver has SOLVE_SECONDS,
and the submission starts no later than SUBMIT_RESERVE before the end, whatever is still missing. A partial bid scores; a late one does not.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import calc
import run as contract
import submit
import team
import web

RUN_SECONDS = 20 * 60
INVESTIGATE_UNTIL = 10 * 60 + 30  # seconds from the start
SOLVE_SECONDS = 150
# entering and signing the bid starts no later than this before the end: a full form (every position through its
# configurator) and the TAN take about four minutes
SUBMIT_RESERVE = 6 * 60
FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS = 75


def log(text: str):
    print(text, flush=True)


async def open_sites(playwright, task: dict) -> list[web.Site]:
    """One browser per website: the run's browsers (up to 4), or locally a Chromium each."""
    available = len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or len(task["access"])
    sites, browser = [], None
    for number, access in enumerate(task["access"]):
        if number < available:
            browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
            context = page.context
        else:  # more websites than browsers: a context of its own in the last one
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
        sites.append(web.Site(access, context, page, log))
    return sites


async def work(task: dict, sites: list[web.Site]) -> dict | None:
    start = time.time()
    end = min(start + RUN_SECONDS, task["expires_at"] / 1000) if task.get("expires_at") else start + RUN_SECONDS
    submit_by = end - SUBMIT_RESERVE

    the_plan = await team.plan(task, start + 120)
    log(f"[team] plan: {json.dumps(the_plan, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    ledger = team.Ledger()
    await team.investigate_all(sites, task, the_plan, ledger, min(start + INVESTIGATE_UNTIL, submit_by - SOLVE_SECONDS))
    log(f"[team] {len(ledger.entries)} records after investigating:")
    for entry in ledger.entries:
        log(f"  {json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}")

    inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by))
    by_id = {site.id: site for site in sites}
    if inputs and inputs.get("missing") and time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS + 30 < submit_by:
        questions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for gap in inputs["missing"]:
            if gap.get("site_id") in by_id:
                questions.setdefault(gap["site_id"], []).append(gap.get("fact", ""))
        if questions:
            log(f"[team] following up on {questions}")
            until = time.time() + FOLLOW_UP_SECONDS
            await asyncio.gather(*(team.follow_up(by_id[site_id], task, the_plan, ledger, asked, until)
                                   for site_id, asked in questions.items()), return_exceptions=True)
            inputs = await team.solve(task, the_plan, ledger, min(time.time() + SOLVE_SECONDS, submit_by)) or inputs
    if inputs:
        for problem in team.mismatches(inputs):
            log(f"[check] {problem}")
    log(f"[team] calculation inputs: {json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    answer, omitted = compute(inputs, the_plan)
    log(f"[team] answer: {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")

    target = by_id.get(task["submission"].get("siteId")) or next(
        (by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "tender" and s["site_id"] in by_id),
        sites[0])
    mail = next((by_id[s["site_id"]] for s in the_plan.get("sites", []) if s.get("kind") == "mail"
                 and s["site_id"] in by_id), None)
    result = await submit.submit(target, mail, task, answer, omitted, end - 20, configurator_values(inputs))
    log(f"[team] submission: {result}")
    return None  # a "site" submission is entered on the website, not returned


def compute(inputs: dict | None, the_plan: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """The answer from the solver's inputs, and the positions left out for lack of facts. Without inputs, an empty
    bid on the planned tender: signed, it still scores its reference and decision."""
    if not inputs:
        return {"tender_reference": the_plan.get("tender_reference", ""), "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR",
                "discount_percent": 0.0, "positions": [], "total_net": 0.0}, []
    answer, steps = calc.compute(inputs)
    for step in steps:
        log(f"[calc] {step}")
    entered = {p["position"] for p in answer["positions"]}
    omitted = [str(p["position"]) for p in inputs.get("positions") or [] if str(p["position"]) not in entered]
    return answer, omitted if answer["decision"] == "bid" else []


def configurator_values(inputs: dict | None) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Per position, the attribute values a bid form's material configurator asks for before it offers materials:
    the chosen material's own values where known, else the requirement's (after amendments and stroke derivation)."""
    values = {}
    for position in (inputs or {}).get("positions") or []:
        material, requirement = position.get("material_attributes") or {}, position.get("requirement") or {}
        values[str(position.get("position"))] = {
            key: material.get(key) or requirement.get(key)
            for key in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
            if material.get(key) or requirement.get(key)}
    return values


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    log(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
        f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}")
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await work(task, await open_sites(playwright, task))
    if answer is None:
        log("No answer to submit through the API")
        return 0
    if not token:
        log(f"Your answer (locally nothing is submitted): {json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    log(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}")
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

Give it a state and up to 4 screenshots, then ask it questions: `choice` picks one of your options, `noul` gives the probability of yes, from 0 to 1, and `score` rates on a scale you set. 3 announcements
--- 1791655098419 | Promote valid test runs to leaderboard
By popular request you can now promote eligible test runs (sub 20 min) to the leaderboard - they go through the same reviewer process as scored submissions.
--- 1791636885463 | Advisory - keep your GitHub repositories private
We were just told by some peers that their repos were public - we advise strongly to keep repositories private and link them to your team. Public ones can be found quite easily and other teams could just copy your work to get a similar score, which would (presumably) be unfortunate.

Feel free to turn the repos public after the hackathon is over though :)
--- 1791632742004 | Concurrent test runs per team bumped to 4 + Bugfixes
We've bumped the concurrent test runs every team can do to 4 to enable quicker iteration speed - we'll keep adjusting this as the challenge goes on and capacity holds up.

+ bug re: linking a gh repo fixed

The spec agent lost time twice:
- **Two model stalls of 60 s each right at the start** ("the model did not answer in time"). That's 2 minutes gone before it did anything.
- Wandering again between the home page and the document register pages.

It has only taken 13 actions in about 5 minutes, and it's **now at the release gate** (receipt number 64431, terms ticked). The requirements should follow shortly, and the ERP is waiting for them.

So the next bottleneck is clear: **slow model calls**. A call that hasn't answered after 60 s is asked again, which wastes a whole minute each time, and the spec agent sits at the start of the ERP's critical path. A candidate fix for later: cut the wait to about 25 s before asking again (a stalled call usually answers quickly on the retry), and drop the reasoning step for plain navigation clicks.

content.text:
Run `94b5` is 10 minutes in. Investigation has finished with **50 records** (run #3 had 38), the solver decided **bid** ("active matching candidates for all five positions"), and the follow-up round is running.

**✅ Going right:**
- **The ERP found every material**:
  - A-1 **HZ-1609**, priced in EUR (and it recognized HZ-8405 as **blocked**)
  - A-2 **HZ-2170**, priced in USD (and it recognized its **2026 price condition as expired**)
  - A-4 **HZ-3916**, priced in USD
  - A-5 **HZ-6932**, details being added in the follow-up

  It also recorded stock correctly split into free and blocked/inspection stock.
- **Mail:** the discount approval (the "-A" look-alike and the "this is not an approval" message both correctly rejected), the **exact metal price index**, delivery commitments and the setup pool.
- **Tender:** Q&A answers with dates, plus the withdrawal.
- **Spec:** the right revision R-6156 and all requirements.
- **No hangs:** the timeouts didn't need to step in, and the ERP kept working until the end.

**❌ Going wrong:**
- **The ERP wasted time on materials nobody needs.** It priced HZ-9275 and HZ-9704 for requirement A-3, which no position uses, and HZ-4889, which doesn't match. It should look up only the requirements the positions refer to.
- **The mail is still missing key facts:**
  - the **exchange rate**: without it, the USD prices of HZ-2170 and HZ-3916 can't be converted, so there are no base prices for 01.02–01.04
  - the **technical release** (end reserves): the follow-up is asking for it now
  - the packaging tariff, condition rules and project bonus
- **The spec agent was slow** at the start (two 60-second model stalls), which made the ERP wait.

The follow-up round is now asking the mail for the end reserves and the ERP for A-5's details. Then comes the bid form with `configure()`.
